Article 82 Admonishment

When considering the agent guilty of committing a crime that gives rise to an abstract imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or a fine, the court may give only an admonishment to him or her, when, cumulatively:
a) The damage of the criminal conduct has already been repaired; b) The agent is a primary delinquent; c) The admonishment is sufficient to achieve criminal prevention and to recover the delinquent. Article 83
Execution of admonishment penalty

The court shall make the admonishment, with a solemn and adequate oral reprimand to the convict, at a public hearing, when the decision that applies that penalty has already transited in rem judicatam. CHAPTER VI ACCESSORY PENALTY

Article 84 General principle

1. The law may establish for certain crimes prohibition from exercising certain rights or professions. 2. An accessory penalty shall be cumulated with other accessory penalties, must be applied together with the principal penalty and its duration must be fixed according to the severity of the guilt. Article 85
Temporary suspension from exercising public function

1. When sentencing a person who exercises a public office with effective imprisonment the court must decree suspension of the exercise of that function during the period that he or she serves the penalty, when the convict does not receive disciplinary dismissal
2. The effects that, according to the respective law, accompany the disciplinary sanction of suspension from exercising the function shall be applied to the convict, during the suspension period. 3. The provisions of the previous numbers shall apply to professions or activities that require a public title, authorization or approval from a public authority to exercise. Article 86 Prohibition from exercising functions

1. A holder of public office, public official or agent of the Administration who, when exercising the activity for which he or she obtained election or appointment to hold, receives a sentence of imprisonment exceeding 3 years may receive prohibition from exercising those functions, for 2 years to 5 years, when the following circumstances arise:
a) The agent committed the act with flagrant and serious abuse of his or her function or with manifest and serious violation of the duty that he or she must fulfill in that function; b) The agent shows manifest unworthiness or incapacity to exercise that office; c) The nature of the act destroys the trust that must exist to exercise that function. 2. The provision of the previous number also applies to professions or activities that a person must have a public title, authorization or approval from a public authority to exercise. 3. The time in which the accused is deprived of his or her liberty because of a coercive measure, penalty or security measure does not count as the period of prohibition. 4. The accessory penalty provided for in this article shall not be applied when, because of those very acts, the security measure provided for in article 100 is already being applied. 5. When applying the provisions of this article, the court's sentence must be notified to the public authority on which the official depends. Article 87 Expulsion

1. A foreign citizen who receives a sentence for committing a crime that gives rise to imprisonment exceeding 3 years and has not yet resided in Timor-Leste for 15 years may receive expulsion from the national territory:
a) For a period up to 2 years, when he or she has already resided here for more than 10 years; b) For a period up to 5 years, when he or she has already resided here for more than 5 years but has not yet reached 10 years; c) For a period up to 10 years, when he or she has not yet resided here for 5 years. 2. The expulsion referred to in the previous number shall be applied when in the concrete case it is indeed necessary for internal security, public health or to prevent criminal activity from continuing. 3. The expulsion penalty shall be executed without regard to the total or partial serving of the principal penalty. Article 88 Prohibition from driving

1. Disqualification from driving a motor vehicle for 3 months to 2 years may be applied to a person who receives a sentence:
a) For a crime provided for in articles 207 to 209; b) For a crime committed with a motorized vehicle and executed with facility indeed because of using a motorized vehicle; c) For a crime of disobedience for refusing to take the test that the law establishes to determine whether a person is driving a motorized vehicle under the disturbing effect on his or her physical, mental
or psychological aptitude of alcohol, psychotropic substances or products with analogous effect. 2. The provision of article 86,  
no. 3, shall also apply here. Article 89
Cancellation of license to possess weapons

1. When there is a sentence for an intentional crime committed with a weapon, considering the circumstances and the seriousness of the conduct, the court may decree cancellation41 of the license to use and possess weapons, for 2 years to 8 years. 2. The provision of article 86,  
no. 3, shall also apply here. CHAPTER VII
DETERMINATION OF PENALTIES

Article 90 General principle

1. When the law fixes a penalty, that penalty refers to that crime in its consummated form. 2. To obtain the abstract penalty framework from which the concrete penalty shall be determined:
a) The modifying circumstances of recidivism and criminal habituality provided for in articles 53 and 54, respectively, shall be applied to the abstract penalty of the consummated crime; b) Following the provision of the previous paragraph or starting from the abstract penalty of the consummated crime, when there are modifying circumstances, the situation that gives rise to extraordinary mitigation shall be considered, when it exists. Article 91
Concrete determination of penalty

1. Having obtained the abstract penalty framework according to the previous article, the court shall assess all circumstances that do not enter into the legal type and do not enter into the valuation as provisions of the previous article but aggravate or diminish the convict's responsibility. 2. Based on the valuation of those latter circumstances, the court shall fix the exact measure of penalty that it considers necessary to protect legal interests essential to life in

41 (89) Cancellation (s) - Annulment

society and for the agent's social reintegration, within the framework that is fixed within the limits of the type or within the limits that result from the provisions of the previous article. 3. The severity of the penalty applied to the convict may never exceed the severity of the guilt. Article 92
Special case of fine penalty

To apply a fine penalty the provisions of this chapter shall be applied to determine the time concerning the duration of the fine, without prejudice to the provision of article 75,  
no. 2, to calculate the amount that corresponds to the fine for each day. CHAPTER VIII SECURITY MEASURES

SECTION I INTERNMENT MEASURE

Article 93 Prerequisites

When a person not imputable according to the provisions of article 21 commits an act described in the legal type of a crime, the court may order his or her admission to an adequate establishment, when, because of his or her psychic anomaly and the nature and seriousness of the committed act, there is a basis to fear that he or she may commit another typical act corresponding to a crime against persons or a crime of common danger. Article 94 Duration

1. When the act that the imputable person committed gives rise to imprisonment up to 3 years, the internment shall not be longer than 1 year. 2. When the imputable person committed an act that corresponds to a crime against persons or a crime of common danger punishable with imprisonment of 5 years or more, the internment shall not be shorter than 3 years, except when it is seen that release does not prejudice the defense of public order and social peace. 3. When the imputable person committed a crime punishable with a penalty (imprisonment) exceeding 8 years and it is better not to release him or her because otherwise he or she may again commit a similar crime, the internment may be extended by a further period of 2 years, successively42, until it is seen that the state of dangerousness that gave rise to that prolongation has ceased. 4. The internment shall not be longer than the maximum limit of the penalty applicable to the crime that the accused committed. Article 95 Cessation of measure

1. The internment measure ends when the criminal dangerousness that gave rise to that measure ceases or, if that dangerousness continues, when the maximum duration of that measure has already been reached, except in the circumstances written in the previous article,  
nos. 3 and 4. 2. The internment measure shall be reviewed every year. 3. When there is an invocation that there is a justifying cause for the internment to end, the court, at a certain moment, shall consider that question. Article 96
Substitution of internment measure

1. Release on probation or, concerning a foreigner, expulsion from the national territory may be placed in place of the internment measure. 2. The provisions of article 87 shall apply to expulsion from the national territory. Article 97 Release on probation

1. When in the review referred to in article 95 it is seen that there is reason to believe that the purpose of the measure can be achieved in an open environment, the court shall place the internee on release on probation. 2. The period of release on probation shall be fixed at a minimum of 2 years to a maximum of 5 years, but shall not exceed the maximum limit fixed in article 94,  
no. 4. 3. The decision concerning release on probation may order the internee to follow, during the suspension period, rules of conduct, necessary to prevent dangerousness, as written in article 70, to follow treatment and an appropriate43 outpatient cure regime and to present himself or herself for examination and observation at the place indicated to him or her. 4. The agent whose execution of his or her internment has been suspended shall be placed under the surveillance of the social reinsertion service. 5. When there is no reason to revoke the release on probation, after the period of release on probation has ended, the internment measure shall be declared extinct. 6. When at the moment that the period of release on probation ends a proceeding or incident that may give rise to the revocation of the measure is ongoing, after that proceeding or incident ends and there is no revocation, the measure may be declared extinct. Article 98
Revocation of release on probation

1. Release on probation shall be revoked when:
a) The imputable person's conduct shows that it is indeed necessary to apply internment; b) The non-imputable person receives a sentence with a penalty that deprives liberty and there are no prerequisites to suspend the execution of that penalty, according to article 68,  
no. 1. 2. Revocation gives rise to re-internment, and the provisions of articles 94 and 96 shall also apply here. Article 99
Suspension of execution of internment

1. The court may order suspension of internment when, according to reason, it can be expected that with that suspension the purpose of the security measure can be achieved and that suspension is compatible with the defense of public order and social peace. 43 (97) Appropriate (adj) – Good for a situation. 2. Article 97,  
nos. 3 and 4, shall also apply to the suspension of internment. 3. The execution of internment shall not be suspended when the agent receives a sentence with a penalty that deprives liberty and there are no requirements to suspend the execution of that penalty as in article 68,  
no. 1. 4. The duration and cessation of internment shall be determined according to articles 94 and 95, respectively44. 5. The provisions of article 98 shall also apply to the decision that suspends the internment measure. SECTION II
OTHER SECURITY MEASURES

Article 100
Professional interdiction measure

1. When a non-imputable person because of psychic anomaly commits some act provided for in the legal type of a crime related to the professional activity that he or she exercises and there is fear that, during the time that he or she exercises that occupation he or she may commit an act similar to that one, the court, considering the circumstances surrounding that case and the non-imputable person's personality, may prohibit him or her from exercising that activity for 1 year to 5 years. 2. The period shall be suspended during the time that the agent does not have liberty because of a procedural coercive measure, penalty or security measure. Article 101
Prohibition from driving and cancellation of license to use and possess weapons

1. A non-imputable person who commits some act provided for in article 88,  
no. 1, may receive disqualification from driving a motor vehicle for 2 years to 6 years, when his or her personality

44 (99) Respectively (adv) – each to each; according to the order shown. The duration and cessation of internment shall be determined according to articles 94 and 95, respectively = The duration of internment according to article 94 and its cessation shall be determined according to article 95. causes fear that he or she may again commit an act similar to that one. 2. When the act that the non-imputable person committed is in relation to the use of weapons, the court may decree cancellation of the license to use and possess weapons for 5 years to 10 years, when his or her personality causes fear that he or she may again commit an act similar to that one. 3. The provision of article 86,  
no. 3, shall also apply here. CHAPTER IX
OTHER CONSEQUENCES OF CRIME

Article 102 Loss of object of crime

1. The object that was used or to be used to commit a crime, or came from a crime, shall be declared lost to the State, when, according to its nature or the circumstances surrounding the case, it causes danger to the safety of persons or to public order, or may be used again to commit a new crime. 2. The victim and third parties who did not contribute to using or producing those objects or deriving advantage from those objects that are their property shall still guarantee their rights. 3. The court shall give a destination to those objects that have already been declared lost, when the law does not say anything, such as ordering the destruction of those objects or making them no longer enter into commerce. 4. The provision of no. 1 shall still apply, even if a person does not receive a penalty for that act. Article 103 Loss of advantage

1. Things, rights or advantages obtained, directly or indirectly, from the commission of a crime shall be declared lost to the State, without prejudice to the rights of the victim or third parties in good faith. 2. When those things, rights or advantages themselves cannot come into the hands of the State, the value of those things, rights or advantages shall be paid to the State. Article 104 Civil liability for crime

1. The court ex officio must ascertain and fix compensation for loss and damage that came from the crime when it is already known that there is damage and what the value of that damage is, except when the injured party declares, according to criminal procedural law, that he or she wants to make the request separately. 2. The norms of civil law regulate the prerequisites and calculation of compensation. 3. The person responsible for compensation may make a transaction concerning that compensation, but must notify the court of that transaction, otherwise that act has no efficacy. Article 105
Privilege of injured party's credit

Credit that arises from the injured party's right to compensation for loss and damage that came from the crime has preference over other credits that arose after the commission of the act, including45 costs and the amount46 concerning the fine. TITLE V RIGHT TO COMPLAINT

Article 106 Nature of crime

1. Concerning the right to make a complaint, crimes may be of a public or semi-public nature. 2. Public crimes are those that do not require a complaint to give rise to criminal proceedings. 3. Semi-public crimes are those that require a complaint to give rise to criminal proceedings. 4. A holder exercises his or her right to complaint when he or she shows that he or she wants criminal proceedings. 45 (105) Including (v) – Counted in all of this; also counted in this; all entered in this; also entered in this. 46 (105) Amount (s) – A sum of money. Article 107
Holder of right to complaint

When a complaint is required to conduct criminal proceedings, the persons that criminal procedural law indicates as holders of the right to complaint have standing to present that complaint. Article 108 Period to exercise right

The right to complaint must be exercised within 6 months and that period counts separately for each holder of that right. Article 109
Renunciation and desistance from complaint

The renunciation, desistance or non-exercise of the right to complaint concerning one participant in the crime benefits the other participants in cases where they also cannot receive criminal prosecution before there is a complaint. TITLE VI EXTINCTION OF CRIMINAL LIABILITY

CHAPTER I
PRESCRIPTION OF CRIMINAL PROCEEDINGS

Article 110 Prescription period

1. Criminal proceedings are extinguished, because of prescription, when, beginning from the moment that the agent committed the crime, the following periods have already passed:
a) 20 years, when concerning a crime punishable with imprisonment with a maximum limit exceeding 12 years; b) 15 years, when concerning a crime punishable with imprisonment with a maximum limit exceeding 7 years but not reaching 12 years; c) 8 years, when concerning a crime punishable with imprisonment with a maximum limit exceeding 3 years but not exceeding 7 years; d) 4 years, in other cases. 2. When the law establishes as an alternative47 for a crime imprisonment or a fine penalty, the former shall be considered for the provisions of this article. Article 111 Counting of period

1. The period for prescription of criminal proceedings begins at the moment that the agent consummated the act or, concerning a non-consummated crime, continued crime or habitual crime, on the day that he or she committed the last act of execution. 2. In permanent crimes the period for prescription begins at the moment that the consummation ends. 3. Concerning complicity only the author's act shall be considered. Article 112 Suspension of prescription

1. Prescription of criminal proceedings is suspended in the cases that the law provides for and also during the time that:
a) According to law, criminal proceedings cannot begin or continue because legal authorization or a sentence that a non-criminal court shall give does not yet exist or because of the devolution of a prejudicial question to a non-criminal judge; b) The delinquent serves abroad a penalty or security measure that deprives liberty; c) Criminal proceedings are already ongoing, beginning from the moment that the accused receives notification concerning the accusation. 2. The proceedings run again at the moment that the cause for suspension ends. 47 (112) Alternative (s) – possibility to choose one thing from two things. Establishes, as an alternative, imprisonment or fine penalty = gives the possibility to choose imprisonment or fine penalty. 3. The cause for suspension shall not be longer than half of the period provided for in article 110, according to each situation. CHAPTER II
PRESCRIPTION OF PENALTIES AND SECURITY MEASURES

Article 113
Period concerning prescription of penalty

1. Penalties shall be prescribed in the following periods:
a) 25 years when exceeding 12 years imprisonment; b) 20 years when exceeding 8 years imprisonment but not exceeding 12 years; c) 12 years when exceeding 4 years imprisonment but not exceeding 8 years; d) 8 years when not imprisonment penalties that the previous paragraphs provide for; e) 4 years when that penalty is a fine penalty. 2. The period concerning prescription of penalty begins at the moment that the decision that applies that penalty obtains transit in rem judicatam. Article 114
Prescription of accessory penalty

Prescription of accessory penalty48 follows the regime of the principal penalty. Article 115
Period for prescription of security measure

Security measures are prescribed in the following periods:
a) 15 years when depriving liberty; b) 5 years when not depriving liberty; c) 2 years when concerning cancellation of license to use and possess weapons. 48 (114) Accessory penalty – Penalty that is applied together with the principal penalty to some criminal, such as prohibition from driving a car or possessing weapons. Article 116 Suspension of prescription

1. Prescription of penalties and security measures is suspended in the cases that the law provides for and during the time that:
a) According to law, execution cannot begin or continue; b) Following the convict's evasion49 and during the time that he or she has not yet been caught again; c) The convict is serving a penalty or security measure that deprives liberty; d) The period to pay the fine is running; e) The convict cannot provide community service temporarily; f) Execution is already ongoing. 2. Prescription runs again on the day that the cause for suspension ends. 3. The provisions of article 112 also apply here.

KAPÍTULU III IMPRESKRITIBILIDADE

Artigu 117
Krime jenosídiu, hasoru paz no umanidade no kona-ba gerra

Prosedimentu kriminál no pena tanba krime jenosídiu, hasoru paz no umanidade no krime gerra la preskreve. KAPÍTULU IV
KAUZA BA EXTINSAUN SELUK

Artigu 118 Kauza seluk

Responsabilidade kriminál extinge iha kazu ne’ebé lei prevee no tanba ajente mate, tanba amnistia no tanba indultu. 49 (116) Evazaun (s) – Ho evazaun ema ida halai tiha hosi kadeia ka fatin ne’ebé nia dadur hela. Artigu 119 Ajente nia mate

Ajente nia mate extinge prosedimentu kriminál no mós sansaun kriminál ne’ebé aplika tiha ona. Artigu 120 Amnistia

Amnistia extinge prosedimentu kriminál no hapara ezekusaun ba sansaun ne’ebé seidauk kumpre totalmente ka parsialmente, no mós sansaun ne’e nia efeitu no pena asesória nu’udar sei bele. Artigu 121
Amnistia no krime iha konkursu

Salvu dispozisaun seluk, amnistia aplika ba krime ida-idak ne’ebé tama iha konkursu. Artigu 122 Indultu

Indultu extinge pena, totalmente ka parsialmente, ka tau pena seluk prevista iha lei no favoravel liu ba kondenadu iha pena ne’e nia fatin. LIVRU II PARTE ESPESIÁL

TÍTULU I
KRIME HASORU PAZ NO UMANIDADE

KAPITULU I
KRIME JENOSÍDIU NO HASORU UMANIDADE

Artigu 123 Jenosídiu

1. Ema ne’ebé, ho intensaun atu destrui, totalmente ka parsialmente, grupu nasionál, étniku, rasiál ka relijiozu, pratika:
a)	Omisídiu ka ofensa ba integridade fízika ka psíkika grave hasoru grupu ne’e; b)	Aktu ne’ebé, oin naran ida, la husik grupu ne’e nia elementu sira halo prokriasaun50 ka moris; c)	Violasaun, eskravidaun seksuál, prostituisaun forsada, esterilizasaun forsada ka violénsia seksuál seluk tan ho gravidade hanesan sira-ne’e; d)	Separasaun ho meiu violentu ba grupu ne’e nia elementu hosi grupu ne’e ba grupu seluk; e)	Aktu ne’ebé, ho violénsia, la husik grupu ne’e ba hela ka hela nafatin iha espasu jeográfiku ne’ebé, tuir tradisaun ka istória, sei konsidera hanesan grupu ne'e nian; f)	Grupu ne’e nia sujeisaun ba kondisaun atu moris ka tratamentu kruél, degradante ka dezumanu, ne’ebé loron ruma bele provoka nia destruisaun totál ka parsiál; g)	Konfisku ka apreensaun jeneralizada ba bem sira-ne’ebé grupu ne’e nia elementu sira nia propriedade; h)	Proibisaun ba grupu ne’e nia elementu sira atu ezerse aktividade komersiál, industriál ka profisionál; i)	Difuzaun51 ba epidemia ne’ebé bele halo grupu ne’e nia elementu sira mate ka hetan ofensa ba sira nia integridade fízika; j)	Proibisaun, omisaun ka impedimentu, ho meiu naran ida, ba grupu ne’e nia elementu sira atu hetan asisténsia umanitária adekuada atu kombate epidemia ka karénsia alimentár grave,
sei hetan pena tinan 15 too tinan 30. 2. Ema ne’ebé, publikamente no diretamente, dada ema seluk ba pratika jenosídiu sei hetan pena tinan 5 too tinan 15. 50 (123) Ho prokriasaun ema ida hetan oan ka jerasaun. 51 (123) Difuzaun (s) – Ho difuzaun ema ida kari buat ruma (ba diresaun hotu-hotu) hodi halo buat ne’e moris ka dait ba ema seluk ka fatin seluk. Halo difuzaun = Kari ka transmite ba ema seluk ka ba fatin seluk

Artigu 124
Krime hasoru umanidade

Ema ne’ebé, iha atake jeneralizadu ka sistemátiku hasoru populasaun sivíl ruma nia kontextu, pratika aktu ne’ebé fó-fatin ba:
a)	Omisídiu ka ofensa ba integridade fízika ka psíkika grave; b)	Extermíniu, ne’ebé iha kuandu ema ruma hatama populasaun ida totalmente ka parsialmente iha kondisaun atu moris adversa, hanesan la husik populasaun ne’e hetan hahán ka ai-moruk, ne’ebé bele halo ema ida ka barak mate; c)	Eskravidaun; d)	Deportasaun ka transferénsia forsada ba populasaun ida, ne’ebé iha kuandu ema ruma halo dezlokasaun ilísita ba ema ida ka barak ba Estadu ka fatin seluk ho expulsaun ka aktu koersivu seluk; e)	Prizaun ka meiu grave seluk ne’ebé hasai ema nia liberdade, hasoru direitu internasionál nia norma ka prinsípiu; f)	Tortura, ne’ebé iha kuandu ema ruma halo buat ruma hodi hamosu dor ka sofrimentu fíziku ka psíkiku grave ba ema ne’ebé lakon tiha ona nia liberdade ka tama tiha ona iha ajente nia kontrolu; g)	Violasaun, eskravidaun seksuál, prostituisaun forsada, gravidéz forsada, esterilizasaun forsada ka violénsia seksuál seluk tan ho gravidade hanesan; h)	Persegisaun, ne’ebé iha kuandu iha privasaun atu goza direitu fundamentál, hasoru direitu internasionál, ba grupu ka koletividade ne’ebé bele identifika, tanba motivu polítiku, rasiál, nasionál, étniku, kulturál, relijiozu, seksu ka motivu seluk tan rekoñesidu universalmente hanesan inaseitavel ba direitu internasionál; i)	Dezaparesimentu forsadu ba ema, ne’ebé iha kuandu iha detensaun , prizaun ka sekuestru52

52 (124) Sekuestru (s) – Ho sekuestru ema ida kaer-metin hela ema ruma no la husik nia sai hosi fatin ne’ebé ajente rai hela nia, hasoru ema ne’e nia hakarak. ne’ebé Estadu ka organizasaun polítika maka halo ka fó autorizasaun, apoiu ka konkordánsia atu halo, no, tuirfali, rekuza atu rekoñese katak privasaun ba liberdade ne’e iha ka atu fó informasaun kona-ba situasaun ne’e ka kona-ba ema sira-ne’e iha ne’ebé atu sira labele hetan lei nia protesaun durante tempu naruk; j)	Apartheit, ne’ebé iha kuandu ema ruma pratika aktu dezumanu iha rejime institusionalizadu ne’ebé grupu rasiál ida ezerse opresaun no domíniu sistemátiku hasoru grupu seluk ida ka barak nia kontextu, ho intensaun atu mantein53 rejime ne’e; k)	Aktu dezumanu seluk tan ho karakter hanesan sira iha kotuk ne'e ho intensaun atu hamosu sofrimentu maka'as ka kanek todan ka afeta saúde mentál ka fízika,
sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 15 too tinan 30. KAPÍTULU II KRIME GERRA

Artigu 125 Krime gerra hasoru ema

1. Ema ne’ebé, iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál ka konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál nia kontextu, pratika hasoru ema ne’ebé direitu internasionál umanitáriu proteje:
a)	Omisídiu; b)	Tortura ka tratamentu kruél, degradante	ka dezumanu, inkluindu experiénsia biolójika; c)	Ofensa grave ba integridade fízika ka aktu ne’ebé hamosu sofrimentu maka'as; d)	Tomada ba refein54; e)	Presaun hodi obriga serví iha forsa armada inimiga ka halo	rekrutamentu ka alistamentu ba

53 (1249 mantein (v) – halo buat ruma ka ema ruma kontinua nafatin; kaer-netik ema buat ruma ka ema ruma. Polísia mantein seguransa = Polísia halo seguransa iha nafatin. mantein apartheit = halo apartheit moris nafatin. 54 (125) Tomada ba refein – Kaer hela ema hanesan garantia hodi ezije buat ruma hosi ema ruma. labarik ho tinan ki’ik liu 18 iha Estadu ida nia forsa armada, forsa militár ka paramilitár ka iha grupu armadu ne’ebé la'ós Estadu nia forsa arma, forsa militár ka paramilitár, ka utiliza sira hodi partisipa iha ostilidade55; f)	Limitasaun grave, prolongada no injustifikada ba ema nia liberdade; g)	Deportasaun ka transferénsia ka privasaun ilegál ba liberdade; h)	Subtrasaun ka destruisaun injustifikada ba bem patrimoniál ho valór boot; i)	Kondenasaun no ezekusaun ba sentensa, kuandu seidauk iha julgamentu justu ka imparsiál; j)	Aktu ne’ebé ofende ema nia dignidade, liuliu ho tratamentu umillante no degradante; k)	Omisídiu ka ferimentu ba kombatente ne’ebé husik tiha ona nia arma ka ne’ebé, laiha ona meiu hodi defende-án, entrega-án tiha ona inkondisionalmente ka oin naran ida hasai-án tiha ona hosi kombate; l)	Aktu sira-ne’ebé artigu anteriór, alínea g), deskreve; m)	Sujeisaun ba ema ne’ebé iha tiha ona parte belijerante ida nia liman atu hetan mutilasaun fízika ka experiénsia médika ka sientífika tipu naran ida, ne’ebé la'ós atu halo tratamentu médiku, dentáriu ka ospitalár no la'ós halo tanba sira nia interese, ne’ebé no halo ema mate ka hamosu perigu maka'as ba ema nia saude; sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 12 too 25. 2. Pena ne’e sei agrava dalimak ida iha nia limite mínimu no másimu kuandu ajente pratika aktu sira referidu iha númeru anteriór hasoru instituisaun umanitária ida nia membru. 3. Ema ne’ebé, iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál nia kontextu:
a)	Transfere, diretamente ka indiretamente, hanesan poténsia okupante, nia populasaun sivíl rasik balu ba territóriu okupadu ka transfere territóriu okupadu nia populasaun, hotu ka balu

55 (125) Ostilidade (s) - Funu

de'it, iha territóriu ne’e nia laran ka sai hosi territóriu ne’e; b)	Obriga prizioneiru iha funu ka ema seluk ne’ebé simu daudaun protesaun serví iha poténsia inimiga nia forsa armada; c)	Funu hotu tiha, atraza prizioneiru iha funu sira nia repatriamentu, sem motivu justifikadu,
sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 15 too 30. Artigu 126
Krime gerra ho métodu proibidu

Ema ne’ebé, iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál ka iha konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál nia kontextu:
a)	Ataka populasaun sivíl em jerál ka sivíl sira-ne’ebé la partisipa diretamente iha ostilidade; b)	Ataka bem sivíl ne’ebé la'ós objetivu militár; c)	Ataka, ho meiu naran ida, aglomeradu populasionál, abitasaun ka edifísiu ne’ebé la defende hela no la'ós objetivu militár; d)	Halo atake indiskriminadu ne’ebé atinje populasaun sivíl ka bem ho karakter sivíl, kuandu hatene katak atake ne’e halo lakon ema nia vida, hamosu kanek ba ema sivíl ka prejuizu ba bem ho karakter sivíl, ne’ebé exesivu; e)	Aproveita ema sivíl ka ema protejidu seluk nia prezensa hodi evita pontu, zona ka forsa militár ruma atu sai operasaun militár nia alvu; f)	Provoka deliberadamente inanisaun ba populasaun sivíl hanesan métodu atu halo funu, ba ida ne’e hasai tiha hosi sira bem ne’ebé sira presiza atu moris; g)	Deklara ka ameasa, ho nia kualidade hanesan ofisiál, katak sei la fó abrigu; h)	Oho ka halo-kanek ho traisaun kombatente inimigu sira; i)	Halo atake ida, maski bele hatene katak atake ne’e hamosu prejuizu boot, duradouru no grave ba meiu ambiente no, tanba ne’e, bele haree kedas

katak atake ne’e exesivu kuandu kompara ho vantajen militár globál konkreta no direta previstu; j)	Komete perfídia, entendidu hanesan aktu oho, halo-kanek ka kaptura, iha ne’ebé, ho intensaun atu lohi, uza adversáriu nia boa-fé hodi halo nia fiar katak nia iha direitu atu simu ka iha obrigasaun atu asegura protesaun ne’ebé direitu internasionál umanitáriu nia regra prevee; sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 15 too tinan 30. Artigu 127
Krime gerra ho meiu ba funu proibidu

1. Ema ne’ebé, iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál ka iha konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál nia kontextu, uza arma, projetil, materiál no métodu ba kombate ne’ebé, tuir nia natureza, hamosu kanek inutil ka sofrimentu deznesesáriu ka hamosu efeitu indiskriminadu, hasoru direitu internasionál aplikavel ba konflitu armadu, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 12 too 25. 2. Númeru anteriór abranje, nomeadamente, meiu sira tuirmai ne’e nia utilizasaun:
a)	Venenu ka arma envenenada; b)	Gas asfiksiante, tóksiku ka similár, ka líkidu, materiál ka dispozitivu análogu naran ida; c)	Kilat-musan ne’ebé expande ka axata fasilmente iha ema nia isin laran, hanesan kilat-musan ne’ebé iha revestimentu toos ne’ebé la taka totalmente nia laran ka iha insizaun; d)	Mina antipesoál; e)	Arma kímika; f)	Arma ne’ebé iha hanesan efeitu prinsipál halo-kanek ho estillasu ne’ebé labele lokaliza iha ema nia isin ho raiu X; g)	Arma insendiária; h)	Arma leizer56 ne’ebé halo matan-delek. 56 (127) Leiser (s) – (laser) Dispozitivu ne’ebé hamosu radiasaun futun ida vizivel, ka ho frekuénsia besik-malu, koerente, monokromátiku no forte tebe-tebes

3. Arma, instrumentu no produtu sira referidu iha númeru anteriór maka sira-ne’ebé direitu internasionál konsidera hanesan ne’e. Artigu 128
Krime gerra hasoru bem protejidu ho insígnia ka emblema distintivu

Ema ne’ebé, iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál ka iha konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál nia kontextu, ataka:
a)	Pesoál, instalasaun, materiál, unidade ka veíkulu ne’ebé partisipa iha misaun atu mantein paz ka fó asisténsia umanitária, nu'udar Nasoens Unidas nia Karta, kuandu sira iha direitu ba protesaun ne’ebé direitu internasionál fó ba ema ka bem sivíl sira; b)	Edifísiu, instalasaun, materiál, unidade ka veíkulu, ne’ebé asinala hela ho Konvensaun iha Jenebra nia emblema distintivu ka pesoál abilitadu atu uza emblema sira-ne’e,
sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 10 too tinan 20. Artigu 129
Krime gerra hasoru propriedade

Ema ne’ebé, iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál ka iha konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál nia kontextu:
a)	Subtrai, destrui ka danifika bem patrimoniál iha eskala larga ka ho valór boot, sem nesesidade militár ka ho forma ilegál ka arbitrária; b)	Ataka, destrui ka danifika edifísiu ne’ebé atu uza ba kultu relijiozu, ba edukasaun, ba arte, ba siénsia ka ba benefisénsia, monumentu kulturál ka istóriku, sítiu arkeolójiku, ospitál no fatin iha ne’ebé tau hamutuk ema moras no kanek, kuandu la'ós objetivu militár; c)	Sakeia57 sidade ka lokalidade ruma, maski hetan ho asaltu,

57 (129) Sakeia (v) – Lelán; noak, hadau ka lori ema seluk nia sasán ho violénsia. sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 5 too tinan 15. Artigu 130
Krime gerra hasoru direitu seluk

Ema ne’ebé, iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál ka iha konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál nia kontextu, deklara abolidu, suspensu ka la admisivel iha tribunál parte inimiga nia nasionál sira nia direitu ka prosedimentu sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 5 too tinan 15. KAPÍTULU III HASORU PAZ NO LIBERDADE

Artigu 131 Organizasaun terrorista

1. Sei konsidera grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun terrorista ema na'in rua ka liu tan ne’ebé, atu realiza finalidade polítika, ideolójika, filozófika ka konfesionál, aktua konsertadamente, ho intensaun atu prejudika integridade ka independénsia nasionál, impede, altera ka subverte instituisaun nasionál ka internasionál sira nia funsionamentu, halo-ta'uk ka obriga autoridade públika, organizasaun internasionál ka ema ruma, grupu ruma ka populasaun em jerál halo buat ruma, la halo buat ruma ka tolera buat ruma, ho krime grave:
a)	Hasoru ema nia vida, integridade fízika ka liberdade; b)	Hasoru transporte no komunikasaun, inkluindu komunikasaun telegráfika, telefónika, ho rádiu ka ho televizaun, sira nia seguransa; c)	Ne’ebé hamosu ho dolu perigu komún, ho inséndiu, explozaun, libertasaun ba substánsia radioativa ka ba gas tóksiku ka asfiksiante, inundasaun ka avalanxe, desmoronamentu ba konstrusaun, kontaminasaun ba alimentu no be ne’ebé ema atu hemu ka difuzaun ba moras, praga, planta ka animál nosivu; d)	Iha ne’ebé sei uza enerjia nukleár, arma de fogu, substánsia ka enjeñu explozivu, meiu insendiáriu

ho natureza naran ida, enkomenda ka karta armadillada; e)	Aktu ne’ebé destrui ka impede meiu ka via ba komunikasaun, servisu públiku sira nia instalasaun ka instalasaun internasionál ka instalasaun atu halo abastesimentu no satisfasaun ba populasaun nia nesesidade vitál, ka dezvia sira hosi sira nia fim normál; f)	Arma biolójika ka kímika nia investigasaun no dezenvolvimentu. 2. Ema ne’ebé promove ka funda grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun terrorista, tama iha, partisipa ka apoia grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun ne’e sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 12 too tinan 25. 3. Ema ne’ebé xefia ka dirije grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun terrorista sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 15 too tinan 30. 4. Kuandu grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun terrorista ka ema sira referidu iha númeru 2 no 3 iha meiu sira-ne’ebé
n. 1, alínea d), hatudu, pena ne'e nia limite mínimu no másimu sei agrava ho datoluk ida. 5. Aktu preparatóriu atu konstitui grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun terrorista sei fó-fatin ba pena ho nia limite mínimu no másimu tun tiha ba sorin balu. 6. Pena referida sira-ne’e bele hetan atenuasaun extraordinária ka la fó-fatin ba punisaun kuandu ajente husik tiha nia aktividade voluntariamente, impede ka haka'as-án duni atu impede perigu ne’ebé aktividade ne’e hamosu ka grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun terrorista ne’e atu kontinua ka fó-hatene ba autoridade katak grupu, organizasaun ka asosiasaun iha, hodi fó-fatin ba autoridade ne’e atu bele evita sira pratika krime. Artigu 132 Terrorizmu

1. Ema ne’ebé pratika krime sira prevista iha artigu anteriór,  
n. 1, alínea a) too c) no e), ka krime naran ida ho meiu sira referidu iha númeru ida-ne’e nia alínea d) ka f), ho intensaun referida iha ne’ebá, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 12 too 25 ka pena korrespondente ba krime pratikadu

ho nia limite mínimu no másimu agravada ho datoluk ida, kuandu pena ne’e hanesan ka todan liu. 2. Pena ne’e bele hetan atenuasaun espesiál ka la fó-fatin ba punisaun kuandu ajente husik tiha nia aktividade voluntariamente, hadook tiha ka hatún konsideravelmente perigu ne’ebé aktividade ne’e hamosu, impede rezultadu ne’ebé lei hakarak evita atu mosu ka ajuda konkretamente hetan prova desiziva atu identifika ka kaptura responsavel seluk. Artigu 133 Finansiamentu ba terrorizmu

Ema ne’ebé, ho meiu naran ida, diretamente ka indiretamente no intensionalmente, fornese, rekolle ka detein fundu ka bem naran ida no mós produtu ka direitu ne’ebé bele transforma ba fundu, buka atu hetan bem, fundu, produtu ka direitu sira-ne’e, ho intensaun atu uza ka hatene katak bele uza, totalmente ka parsialmente, hodi planeia, prepara ka pratika aktu sira-ne’ebé artigu 131,  
n. 1, prevee ka pratika aktu sira-ne’e ho intensaun referida iha artigu 132,  
n. 1, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 12 too tinan 25. Artigu 134 Insitamentu ba gerra

1. Ema ne’ebé, ho meiu naran ida, publikamente no repetidamente, insita58 ódiu hasoru rasa, povu ka nasaun ruma, ho intensaun atu provoka funu ka atu impede konvivénsia pasífika entre rasa, povu ka nasaun diversu59, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. 2. Ema ne’ebé alisia60 ka rekruta sidadaun timór ka estranjeiru atu, ho servisu ne’ebé halo ba grupu ka poténsia estranjeira, halo funu hasoru Estadu ida ka hatún

58 (134) Insita (v) – Fó korajen; dada (ema) ba halo buat ruma; fó estímulu; alisia. Insita ódiu hasoru rasa ida = haburas ódiu hasoru rasa ida. 59 (134) Diversu (adj) – Diferente; oioin; ne’ebé la hanesan; ne’ebé la’ós ida de’it; ne’ebé iha aspetu la hanesan; ne’ebé la’ós oin ida de’it. 60 (134) Alisia (v) – Dada (ema ida) ba halo buat ruma; fó korajen ka estímulu. estadu seluk nia governu lejítimu ho meiu violentu sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 5 too tinan 15. Artigu 135 Diskriminasaun rasiál ka relijioza

1. Ema ne'ebé funda, konstitui organizasaun ka dezenvolve propaganda organizada hodi insita ka enkoraja atu halo diskriminasaun, ódiu ka violénsia rasiál ka relijioza, no mós ema ne’ebé partisipa ka fó asisténsia, inkluindu finansiamentu, ba organizasaun ka aktividade sira-ne’e sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 4 too tinan 12. 2. Ema ne’ebé, iha reuniaun públika, ho eskritu atu halo divulgasaun ka ho meiu ba komunikasaun sosiál naran ida, difunde ideia ho intensaun atu insita halo diskriminasaun rasiál ka relijioza ka atu enkoraja ka provoka aktu violentu hasoru ema ka grupu ruma tanba nia rasa, kor, orijen étnika ka relijiaun, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. KAPÍTULU IV DISPOZISAUN KOMÚN

Artigu 136
Xefe militár ka superiór seluk nia responsabilidade

1. Xefe militár ka se maka aktua hanesan xefe militár ne’ebé, hatene tiha katak forsa ne’ebé tama iha nia komandu no kontrolu efetivu ka iha nia responsabilidade no kontrolu efetivu komete daudaun krime ruma previstu iha títulu ida ne’e, la adota medida nesesária no adekuada hodi prevene ka reprime prátika ne’e ka hodi fó-hatene kedas ba autoridade kompetente sei hetan pena korrespondente ba krime ne’e ka ba krime ne’ebé sei halo duni. 2. Númeru anteriór nia dispozisaun sei aplika mós, ho adaptasaun nesesária, ba superiór kona-ba kontrolu ba subordinadu sira-ne’ebé tama iha nia autoridade no kontrolu efetivu. Artigu 137

Definisaun
Ba títulu ida ne’e nia efeitu, sei konsidera:
a)	“Konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál” ida ne’ebé:
i)	Akontese entre estadu sira, maski laiha deklarasaun de gerra formál, maski Estadu sira-ne’e ida la rekoñese estadu de gerra ne’e; ii)	Korresponde ba okupasaun totál ka parsiál iha Estadu ida nia territóriu, maski okupasaun ne’e la hasoru rezisténsia militár; iii)	Korresponde ba situasaun iha ne’ebé povu sira luta hasoru dominasaun koloniál, okupasaun estranjeira no rejime ne’ebé halo segregasaun, kuandu povu ezerse nia direitu ba autodeterminasaun konsagradu iha Nasoens Unidas nia Karta no iha deklarasaun kona-ba direitu internasionál nia prinsípiu kona-ba relasaun amigavel no kooperasaun entre Estadu sira; b)	“Konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál” ida ne’ebé akontese iha Estadu ida nia territóriu, iha karakter prolongadu no tau autoridade governamentál sira hasoru grupu organizadu sira ka grupu organizadu sira hasoru malu, ho exesaun ba situasaun iha ne’ebé iha distúrbiu no iha ne’ebé iha tensaun interna, hanesan aktu esporádiku ka izoladu ho violénsia ka seluk tan ho karakter hanesan; c)	“Pesoa protejida”:
i)	Iha konflitu armadu internasionál, ema protejidu sira ba Konvensaun iha Jenebra 1949 no Protokolu Adisionál I nia efeitu, nomeadamente ema kanek, ema moras, ema náufragu, ema prizioneiru iha gerra, pesoál sanitáriu ka relijiozu sira no populasaun sivíl; ii)	Iha konflitu armadu ho karakter la internasionál, ema kanek, ema moras no ema náufragu sira, no mós ema sira-ne’ebé la hola parte aktiva iha ostilidade maibé tama iha inimigu nia liman; iii)	Iha konflitu armadu ho karakter internasionál no iha konflitu armadu ho karakter nasionál, forsa armada nia membru sira no parte

inimiga nia kombatente sira-ne’ebé husik tiha ona sira nia arma ka laiha meiu ba defeza seluk tan. TÍTULU II KRIME HASORU EMA

KAPÍTULU I HASORU VIDA

Artigu 138 Omisídiu simples

Ema ne’ebé oho ema seluk sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 8 too tinan 20. Artigu 139 Omisídiu agravadu

Ajente ne’ebé oho ema seluk iha sirkunstánsia ne’ebé hatudu sensurabilidade ka perversidade espesiál, nomeadamente, tanba:
a)	Uza venenu, tortura, asfiksia, ahi, explozivu ka meiu insidiozu seluk ka meiu ne’ebé konstitui krime ba perigu komún nia prátika, ka aktu kruél seluk, hodi aumenta vítima nia sofrimentu; b)	Uza disimulasaun ka meiu ka rekursu seluk hodi halo vítima iha difikuldade atu defende-án ka labele defende-án; c)	Oho tanba avidéz61, tanba gosta oho ema, tanba hakarak hetan exitasaun ka satisfasaun seksuál, tanba pagamentu ka rekompensa ka promesa kona-ba pagamentu ka rekompensa ka tanba motivu futil ka torpe seluk; d)	Oho atu prepara, ezekuta ka subar krime seluk, fasilita fuga ka asegura impunidade ba krime ida nia ajente; e)	Oho tanba ódiu rasiál, relijiozu ka polítiku; 61 (139) Avidéz – Dezeju maka’as no la hotu; ka’an-ten (adj); matan-fuan naklosu (ba buat ruma)

f)	Oho ho premeditasaun, ne’ebé iha kuandu nia uza frieza62 de ánimu, reflesaun kona-ba meiu ne’ebé uza ka rai nia intensaun atu oho durante oras 24; g)	Kuandu vítima ajente nia kónjuje, dexendente, axendente, kolaterál ka afín too grau da-rua, adotadu ka ema ne’ebé moris ho nia hanesan iha ne’ebé iha dependénsia ierárkika, ekonómika ka laborál; h)	Vítima ema vulneravel tebes tanba nia idade, moras ka defisiénsia fízika ka psíkika; i)	Vítima órgaun soberanu ka órgaun polítiku konstitusionál nia membru, órgaun ba administrasaun nia membru, majistradu, defensór, advogadu, ofisiál ba justisa, funsionáriu ka ema seluk tan ne’ebé kaer servisu públiku, naran katak nia kaer daudaun nia funsaun ka tanba funsaun ne’ebé nia kaer; j)	Vítima ema testemuña, deklarante, peritu, lezadu ka ofendidu no ajente pratika krime ne’e hodi impede depoimentu, denúnsia kona-ba faktu ka keixa ka tanba nia intervensaun iha prosesu,
sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 12 too tinan 25. Artigu 140 Omisídiu neglijente

1. Ema ne’ebé, tanba neglijénsia, oho ema seluk sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 4 ka pena multa. 2. Iha kazu ne’ebé ajente aktua ho neglijénsia groseira63 nia sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 5. Artigu 141* Interrupsaun ba gravidéz

62 (139) Frieza de ánimu – laran malirin
63 (140) Groseira (adj) – Groseira (adj) – Todan; maka’as. Neglijénsia groseira = neglijénsia todan; laiha kuidadu ne’ebé todan. Ema ida halo buat ruma ho neglijénsia groseira kuandu nia laiha liu kuidadu kuandu nia halo buat ne’e. 1. Ema ne’ebé halo feto isin-rua aborta, ho meiu naran ida no sem feto ne’e nia konsentimentu, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. 2. Ema ne’ebé halo feto isin-rua aborta, ho meiu naran ida no ho feto ne’e nia konsentimentu, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3. 3. Feto isin-rua ne’ebé fó konsentimentu ba ema seluk atu pratika abortu, ka, nia rasik ka hodi ema seluk, provoka abortu ba nia an sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3. 4. Númeru anteriór nia dispozisaun la aplika kuandu, tuir koñesimentu no experiénsia médika ne'ebé iha ona no halo tiha buat hotu ne'ebé bele halo atu salva feto isin-rua no fetu ka embriaun nia vida, interrupsaun ba gavidéz maka bele hadook mate hosi feto isin-rua, naran katak iha sertifikasaun médika no médiku maka halo ka profisionál seluk iha saúde maka halo, ho médiku nia diresaun, iha estabelesimentu ba saude públiku ka ofisialmente rekoñesidu, no ho feto isin-rua nia konsentimentu. 5. Molok halo interrupsaun painél ida ho médiku na'in tolu tenke sertifika sirkunstánsia sira referida iha númeru anteriór, iha atestadu médiku eskritu no asinadu; iha painél ne'e halo parte médiku ida-ne'ebé realiza ka superviziona interrupsaun ba gravidéz nia realizasaun. 6. Konsentimentu feto isin-rua maka sei fó rasik iha dokumentu eskritu no asinadu, rona tiha, kuandu bele, nia kónjuje ka ema ne'ebé moris ho nia hanesan lain ho feen, ka ema seluk, tuir feto ne'e nia pedidu, maka fó, no, kuandu bele, sei fó tiha loron rua uluk molok atu halo interrupsaun ne'e. 7. Kuandu feto isin-rua ema menór ida, nia reprezentante legál maka sei fó konsentimentu. 8. Kuandu feto isin-rua maiór ka emansipada ema inkapáz psikikamente ida ka ema-ne'ebé sofre hela inkapasidade psíkika, nia kónjuje ka ema ne'ebé moris ho nia hanesan lain ho feen, ka nia reprezentante legál, axendente ka dexendente, ka, laiha karik, nia parente kolaterál ruma, respetiva no susesivamente, maka fó konsentimentu ne'e. 9. Kuandu labele hetan atestadu médiku referidu iha n. 5 no/ka labele hetan konsentimentu nu'udar hakerek hela iha
n. 6 too 8, no interrupsaun tenke halo lalais no labele hein tan ona, médiku, haree ba situasaun ida-idak, maka sei

deside, uza mós, kuandu bele, médiku seluk sira nia paresér. 10. Iha painél referidu iha n. 5 sei tama médiku ne'ebé iha koñesimentu adekuadu atu avalia sirkunstánsia ne'ebé justifika interrupsaun ba gravidéz, no, kuandu bele, médiku jinekolojista/obstetra ida. 11. Médiku sira-ne'ebé emite atestadu médiku no médiku sira-ne'ebé realiza ka superviziona interrupsaun ba gravidéz nia realizasaun tenke fó esklaresimentu nesesáriu ba feto isin-rua no, kuandu tama iha situasaun ne'e, ba ema sira-ne'ebé n. 7 no 8 refere, nomeadamente kona-ba métodu atu uza iha interrupsaun, interrupsaun ne'e nia efeitu rasik no nia konsekuénsia ba feto isin-rua nia saude fízika no psíkika. 12. Médiku no profisionál ba saude seluk sira iha direitu atu aprezenta objesaun tuir sira-nia konxiénsia hasoru aktu ruma kona-ba interrupsaun ba gravidéz. 13. Médiku no profisionál ba saude seluk sira-ne'ebé invoka objesaun tuir sira-nia konxiénsia tenke garante profisionál iha saúde seluk nia intervensaun imediata iha aktu sira-ne'ebé tenke halo no mós akompañamentu imediatu ba feto isin-rua. 14. Objesaun tuir konxiénsia tenke hatudu expresamente no tenke fó-hatene ba responsavel klíniku iha estabelesimentu ba saude iha ne'ebé objetór servisu. * Lei 6/2009, iha 15 Jullu, maka hatama redasaun ida-ne’e. Artigu 141 nia redasaun anteriór maka ida tuirmai ne’e:
Artigu 141 Interrupsaun ba gravidéz
1. Ema ne’ebé halo feto isin-rua aborta, ho meiu naran ida no sem feto ne’e nia konsentimentu, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. 2. Ema ne’ebé halo feto isin-rua aborta, ho meiu naran ida no ho feto ne’e nia konsentimentu, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3. 3. Feto isin-rua ne’ebé fó konsentimentu ba ema seluk atu pratika abortu, ka, nia rasik ka hodi ema seluk, provoka abortu ba nia an sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3. 4. Númeru anteriór sira nia dispozisaun la aplika iha kazu ne’ebé interrupsaun ba gravidéz konstitui meiu úniku hodi evita perigu ba feto isin-rua ka ba fetu atu mate ka hetan lezaun grave no irreversivel ba nia isin ka ba nia saude fízika ka psíkika, naran katak médiku ka profisionál iha saude maka halo, iha estabelesimentu ba saúde, ho junta médika nia autorizasaun no supervizaun no ho feto isin-rua ka nia kónjuje nia konsentimentu. 5. Lejislasaun ketak sei regula n. 4 nia dispozisaun

Artigu 142 Infantisídiu

1. Se maka intensionalmente hamosu perigu ba ema seluk nia vida:
a)	Tanba hatama ema ne’e iha fatin ne’ebé nia tenke hasoru situasaun iha ne’ebé nia labele defende-án mesak; ka
b)	Tanba soe hela ema ne’e kuandu nia labele defende-án tanba nia idade, defisiénsia fízika ka moras, no ajente iha obrigasaun atu haree, hein ka fó asisténsia ba ema ne'e,
sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 1 too tinan 6. 2. Kuandu faktu ne’e:
a)	Hamosu ofensa grave ba vítima nia integridade fízika, ajente sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8; b)	Halo vítima mate , ajente sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 5 too tinan 15. 3. Kuandu vítima ne’e ajente nia kónjuje, dexendente, axendente, kolaterál, afín too grau daruak, adotante ka adotadu, ka ema ne’ebé moris ho nia hanesan feen ho lain, pena ne’ebé hatudu hela iha númeru anteriór sira nia limite mínimu no másimu sei sa'e tan datoluk ida. Artigu 144 Insitamentu ka ausíliu ba suisídiu

1. Se maka insita ema seluk atu oho-án ka fó-asisténsia ba ema seluk atu oho-án, suisídiu ne’e akontese duni ho forma tentada ka konsumada karik, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 2. Kuandu ajente pratika faktu sira deskritu iha númeru anteriór ba ema ruma ne’ebé artigu anteriór, númeru 3, hatudu ka ba menór ho tinan ki'ik liu 17 ka ba ema ne’ebé iha kapasidade diminuida sensivelmente atu halo valorasaun ka determinasaun, pena ne’e sei sa'e ba prizaun too tinan 5. 3. Ema ne’ebé, oin naran ida no repetidamente, halo propaganda públika ba suisídiu sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 2 ka multa. KAPÍTULU II

Artigu 145
Ofensa ba integridade fízika simples

1. Se maka ofende ema seluk nia isin ka saúde sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 2. Atu hala'o prosedimentu kriminál tenke iha keixa. Artigu 146
Ofensa ba integridade fízika grave

Se maka ofende ema seluk nia isin ka saúde ho intensaun atu:
a)	Halo ema ne’e lakon nia órgaun ka membru ruma; b)	Desfigura ema ne’e gravemente no permanentemente; c)	Afeta gravemente no permanentemente ka definitivamente ema ne’e nia kapasidade atu kaer servisu, nia kapasidade intelektuál ka nia kapasidade atu iha oan; d)	Provoka doensa permanente ka anomalia psíkika inkuravel; ka

sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. Artigu 147 Agravasaun

Se maka, hakarak halo de'it ofensa prevista iha artigu 146, maibé halo ema mate tanba neglijénsia, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 4 too tinan 12. 3. Kuandu ajente halo krime sira referidu iha artigu rua anteriór ne’e hasoru ema ruma ne’ebé artigu 139, alínea i), temi, tanba vítima ne’e kaer funsaun ne’ebé hakerek hela iha ne’ebá ka kuandu vítima ne’e kaer daudaun nia funsaun ne’e, pena ne’e sei agrava datoluk ida iha nia limite mínimu no másimu, kuandu dispozisaun legál seluk la prevee pena todan liu. Artigu 148
Ofensa ba integridade fízika neglijente

1. Se maka ofende ema seluk nia isin ka saúde tanba neglijénsia sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 1 ka multa. 2. Neglijénsia ne’e groseira karik, ajente sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 2 ka multa. 3. Kuandu faktu ne’e hamosu ofensa korporál grave ajente sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 4.

CHAPTER III IMPRESCRIPTIBILITY

Article 117
Crimes of genocide, against peace and humanity and relating to war

Criminal proceedings and penalties for crimes of genocide, against peace and humanity and war crimes do not prescribe. CHAPTER IV
OTHER CAUSES OF EXTINCTION

Article 118 Other causes

Criminal responsibility is extinguished in cases provided by law and by the death of the agent, by amnesty and by pardon. 49 (116) Evasion (s) – By evasion a person flees from prison or the place where he or she is detained. Article 119 Death of the agent

The death of the agent extinguishes criminal proceedings and also the criminal sanction already applied. Article 120 Amnesty

Amnesty extinguishes criminal proceedings and stops the execution of sanctions not yet fully or partially complied with, and also the effects of such sanctions and accessory penalties as may be. Article 121
Amnesty and crimes in concurrence

Unless otherwise provided, amnesty applies to each crime included in the concurrence. Article 122 Pardon

Pardon extinguishes the penalty, totally or partially, or substitutes another penalty provided in law and more favourable to the convicted person in place of that penalty. BOOK II SPECIAL PART

TITLE I
CRIMES AGAINST PEACE AND HUMANITY

CHAPTER I
CRIMES OF GENOCIDE AND AGAINST HUMANITY

Article 123 Genocide

1. A person who, with intent to destroy, totally or partially, a national, ethnic, racial or religious group, commits:
a) Homicide or serious offence against the physical or psychological integrity of that group; b) Acts which, in any way, prevent the members of that group from procreating50 or living; c) Rape, sexual slavery, forced prostitution, forced sterilization or other sexual violence of similar gravity; d) Violent separation of members of that group from that group to another group; e) Acts which, by violence, prevent that group from residing or continuing to reside in a geographical space which, according to tradition or history, is considered as belonging to that group; f) Subjection of that group to living conditions or cruel, degrading or inhuman treatment, which may one day lead to its total or partial destruction; g) Widespread confiscation or seizure of property belonging to members of that group; h) Prohibition of members of that group from exercising commercial, industrial or professional activities; i) Spreading51 of epidemics which may cause the death of members of that group or offence to their physical integrity; j) Prohibition, omission or impediment, by any means, of members of that group from receiving adequate humanitarian assistance to combat epidemics or serious food shortages,
shall be punished with imprisonment from 15 to 30 years. 2. A person who, publicly and directly, incites others to commit genocide shall be punished with imprisonment from 5 to 15 years. 50 (123) By procreation a person has children or generations. 51 (123) Diffusion (s) – By diffusion a person spreads something (in all directions) thereby making that thing live or reach other people or other places. To diffuse = To spread or transmit to others or to other places

Article 124
Crimes against humanity

A person who, in the context of a widespread or systematic attack against any civilian population, commits acts which give rise to:
a) Homicide or serious offence against physical or psychological integrity; b) Extermination, which exists when someone subjects a population totally or partially to adverse living conditions, such as preventing that population from obtaining food or medicine, which may cause the death of one or many persons; c) Enslavement; d) Deportation or forced transfer of a population, which exists when someone makes an unlawful displacement of one or many persons to another State or place by expulsion or other coercive acts; e) Imprisonment or other serious means which deprive a person of liberty, contrary to norms or principles of international law; f) Torture, which exists when someone does something to cause serious physical or psychological pain or suffering to a person who has already lost his or her liberty or has already come under the agent's control; g) Rape, sexual slavery, forced prostitution, forced pregnancy, forced sterilization or other sexual violence of similar gravity; h) Persecution, which exists when there is deprivation of the enjoyment of fundamental rights, contrary to international law, of a group or collectivity which can be identified, by reason of political, racial, national, ethnic, cultural, religious, gender or other motives universally recognized as unacceptable under international law; i) Forced disappearance of persons, which exists when there is detention, imprisonment or kidnapping52

52 (124) Kidnapping (s) – By kidnapping a person seizes and holds another person and does not let him or her leave the place where the agent is holding him or her, against that person's will. which the State or political organization carries out or gives authorization, support or agreement to carry out, and, consequently, refuses to recognize that such deprivation of liberty exists or to provide information about that situation or about those persons so that they cannot obtain the protection of the law for a long time; j) Apartheid, which exists when someone commits inhuman acts in the context of an institutionalized regime in which one racial group exercises systematic oppression and domination over one or more other groups, with the intent to maintain53 that regime; k) Other inhuman acts of similar character to those above with intent to cause serious suffering or serious injury or to affect mental or physical health,
shall be punished with imprisonment from 15 to 30 years. CHAPTER II WAR CRIMES

Article 125 War crimes against persons

1. A person who, in the context of an armed conflict of international character or an armed conflict of non-international character, commits against persons protected by international humanitarian law:
a) Homicide; b) Torture or cruel, degrading or inhuman treatment, including biological experiments; c) Serious offence against physical integrity or acts which cause serious suffering; d) Taking of hostages54; e) Compelling to serve in the enemy armed forces or the recruitment or enlistment of

53 (1249 maintain (v) – to make something or someone continue; to hold something or someone. Police maintain security = Police keep security in place. maintain apartheid = make apartheid continue to exist. 54 (125) Taking of hostages – Holding a person as a guarantee to demand something from someone. children under 18 years of age in the armed forces, military forces or paramilitary forces of a State, or in armed groups which are not the armed forces, military forces or paramilitary forces of a State, or using them to participate in hostilities55; f) Serious, prolonged and unjustified limitation of a person's liberty; g) Deportation or transfer or unlawful deprivation of liberty; h) Unjustified subtraction or destruction of patrimonial property of great value; i) Conviction and execution of sentence, when there has not yet been a fair or impartial trial; j) Acts which offend a person's dignity, especially by humiliating and degrading treatment; k) Homicide or wounding of a combatant who has already laid down his or her arms or who, having no more means to defend himself or herself, has already surrendered unconditionally or has in any way already been removed from combat; l) Acts described in the previous article, paragraph g); m) Subjecting persons who have already come into the hands of one belligerent party to physical mutilation or medical or scientific experiments of any type, which are not for medical, dental or hospital treatment and are not done in their interest, and which cause death or serious danger to a person's health; shall be punished with imprisonment from 12 to 25 years. 2. The penalty shall be aggravated by one fifth in its minimum and maximum limits when the agent commits the acts referred to in the previous number against a member of a humanitarian institution. 3. A person who, in the context of an armed conflict of international character:
a) Transfers, directly or indirectly, as an occupying power, part of its own civilian population to the occupied territory or transfers the population of the occupied territory, all or part

only, within that territory or out of that territory; b) Compels prisoners of war or other persons receiving protection to serve in the enemy power's armed forces; c) After the war has ended, delays the repatriation of prisoners of war, without justified motive,
shall be punished with imprisonment from 15 to 30 years. Article 126
War crimes by prohibited methods

A person who, in the context of an armed conflict of international character or in an armed conflict of non-international character:
a) Attacks the civilian population in general or civilians who do not directly participate in hostilities; b) Attacks civilian property which is not a military objective; c) Attacks, by any means, population centres, dwellings or buildings which are not being defended and are not military objectives; d) Makes an indiscriminate attack which affects the civilian population or property of civilian character, knowing that the attack will cause loss of life, injury to civilians or damage to property of civilian character, which is excessive; e) Takes advantage of the presence of civilians or other protected persons to prevent certain points, zones or military forces from becoming the target of military operations; f) Deliberately causes starvation of the civilian population as a method of warfare, thereby removing from them property which they need to live; g) Declares or threatens, in his or her capacity as an officer, that no shelter will be given; h) Kills or injures by treachery enemy combatants; i) Makes an attack, even knowing that the attack will cause serious, lasting and grave damage to the environment and, therefore, it can be clearly seen

that the attack is excessive when compared with the concrete and direct overall military advantage foreseen; j) Commits perfidy, understood as acts of killing, injuring or capturing, in which, with intent to deceive, the adversary's good faith is used to make him or her believe that he or she has the right to receive or has the obligation to ensure protection which the rules of international humanitarian law provide; shall be punished with imprisonment from 15 to 30 years. Article 127
War crimes by prohibited means of warfare

1. A person who, in the context of an armed conflict of international character or an armed conflict of non-international character, uses weapons, projectiles, materials and methods of combat which, according to their nature, cause unnecessary injury or unnecessary suffering or produce indiscriminate effects, contrary to international law applicable to armed conflicts, shall be punished with imprisonment from 12 to 25 years. 2. The previous number covers, in particular, the use of the following means:
a) Poison or poisoned weapons; b) Asphyxiating, toxic or similar gases, or any liquids, materials or analogous devices; c) Bullets which expand or flatten easily in the human body, such as bullets which have a hard casing which does not completely cover the core or which has incisions; d) Anti-personnel mines; e) Chemical weapons; f) Weapons whose principal effect is to injure by fragments which cannot be located in the human body by X-rays; g) Incendiary weapons; h) Laser56 weapons which cause blindness. 56 (127) Laser (s) – (laser) A device which produces a visible light radiation, or with close frequencies, coherent, monochromatic and very strong

3. The weapons, instruments and products referred to in the previous number are those which international law considers as such. Article 128
War crimes against property protected by distinctive insignia or emblem

A person who, in the context of an armed conflict of international character or an armed conflict of non-international character, attacks:
a) Personnel, installations, materials, units or vehicles participating in a mission to maintain peace or provide humanitarian assistance, under the United Nations Charter, when they have the right to protection which international law gives to persons or civilian property; b) Buildings, installations, materials, units or vehicles, which are marked with the distinctive emblem of the Geneva Conventions or personnel authorized to use such emblems,
shall be punished with imprisonment from 10 to 20 years. Article 129
War crimes against property

A person who, in the context of an armed conflict of international character or an armed conflict of non-international character:
a) Subtracts, destroys or damages patrimonial property on a large scale or of great value, without military necessity or in an unlawful or arbitrary manner; b) Attacks, destroys or damages buildings dedicated to religious worship, education, art, science or charity, cultural or historical monuments, archaeological sites, hospitals and places where sick and wounded persons are gathered, when they are not military objectives; c) Pillages57 any city or locality, even if taken by assault,

57 (129) Pillage (v) – To plunder; to steal, seize or carry away another person's possessions by violence. shall be punished with imprisonment from 5 to 15 years. Article 130
War crimes against other rights

A person who, in the context of an armed conflict of international character or an armed conflict of non-international character, declares abolished, suspended or inadmissible in court the rights or proceedings of nationals of the enemy party shall be punished with imprisonment from 5 to 15 years. CHAPTER III AGAINST PEACE AND FREEDOM

Article 131 Terrorist organization

1. A group, organization or association of two or more persons shall be considered terrorist when, in order to achieve political, ideological, philosophical or confessional ends, they act in concert, with intent to prejudice national integrity or independence, prevent, alter or subvert the functioning of national or international institutions, intimidate or compel public authorities, international organizations or any person, group or population in general to do something, not do something or tolerate something, by serious crimes:
a) Against the life, physical integrity or liberty of persons; b) Against the safety of transport and communications, including telegraphic, telephonic, radio or television communications; c) Which deliberately cause common danger, by fire, explosion, release of radioactive substances or toxic or asphyxiating gases, flood or avalanche, collapse of construction, contamination of food and drinking water or spreading of disease, harmful plants or animals; d) In which nuclear energy, firearms, explosive substances or devices, incendiary means

of any nature, letter or parcel bombs will be used; e) Acts which destroy or impede means or ways of communication, installations of public services or international installations or installations for supply and satisfaction of the population's vital needs, or divert them from their normal purpose; f) Research and development of biological or chemical weapons. 2. A person who promotes or founds a terrorist group, organization or association, joins, participates in or supports such group, organization or association shall be punished with imprisonment from 12 to 25 years. 3. A person who leads or directs a terrorist group, organization or association shall be punished with imprisonment from 15 to 30 years. 4. When the terrorist group, organization or association or the persons referred to in numbers 2 and 3 possess the means shown in
no. 1, paragraph d), the minimum and maximum limits of the penalty shall be aggravated by one third. 5. Preparatory acts to constitute a terrorist group, organization or association shall give rise to a penalty with its minimum and maximum limits reduced by half. 6. The penalties referred to may receive extraordinary attenuation or not give rise to punishment when the agent voluntarily abandons his or her activity, prevents or makes great efforts to prevent the danger which that activity causes or the terrorist group, organization or association from continuing or informs the authorities that the group, organization or association exists, thereby enabling those authorities to prevent them from committing crimes. Article 132 Terrorism

1. A person who commits the crimes provided in the previous article,  
no. 1, paragraphs a) to c) and e), or any crime by the means referred to in number one's paragraphs d) or f), with the intent referred to therein, shall be punished with imprisonment from 12 to 25 years or the penalty corresponding to the crime committed

with its minimum and maximum limits aggravated by one third, when that penalty is equal or heavier. 2. The penalty may receive special attenuation or not give rise to punishment when the agent voluntarily abandons his or her activity, removes or considerably reduces the danger which that activity causes, prevents the result which the law seeks to avoid from occurring or concretely helps to obtain decisive evidence to identify or capture other responsible persons. Article 133 Financing of terrorism

A person who, by any means, directly or indirectly and intentionally, provides, collects or holds funds or any property and also products or rights which can be converted into funds, seeks to obtain such property, funds, products or rights, with intent to use or knowing that they may be used, totally or partially, to plan, prepare or commit the acts provided in article 131,  
no. 1, or to commit such acts with the intent referred to in article 132,  
no. 1, shall be punished with imprisonment from 12 to 25 years. Article 134 Incitement to war

1. A person who, by any means, publicly and repeatedly, incites58 hatred against any race, people or nation, with intent to provoke war or to impede peaceful coexistence between diverse59 races, peoples or nations, shall be punished with imprisonment from 2 to 8 years. 2. A person who entices60 or recruits Timorese or foreign citizens to, by service performed for a foreign group or power, make war against a State or overthrow

58 (134) Incite (v) – To give courage; to incite (someone) to do something; to give stimulus; to entice. Incite hatred against a race = to stir up hatred against a race. 59 (134) Diverse (adj) – Different; various; which is not the same; which is not only one; which has different aspects; which is not only one kind. 60 (134) Entice (v) – To incite (someone) to do something; to give courage or stimulus. another state's legitimate government by violent means shall be punished with imprisonment from 5 to 15 years. Article 135 Racial or religious discrimination

1. A person who founds, constitutes an organization or develops organized propaganda to incite or encourage racial or religious discrimination, hatred or violence, and also a person who participates in or gives assistance, including financing, to such organizations or activities shall be punished with imprisonment from 4 to 12 years. 2. A person who, in a public meeting, by writing for dissemination or by any means of social communication, disseminates ideas with intent to incite racial or religious discrimination or to encourage or provoke violent acts against any person or group because of his or her race, colour, ethnic origin or religion, shall be punished with imprisonment from 2 to 8 years. CHAPTER IV COMMON PROVISIONS

Article 136
Responsibility of military commander or other superior

1. A military commander or one who acts as military commander who, having known that forces under his or her command and effective control or under his or her responsibility and effective control are committing or are about to commit any crime provided in this title, does not adopt necessary and adequate measures to prevent or repress such practice or to immediately inform the competent authorities shall be punished with the penalty corresponding to that crime or to the crime which will be committed. 2. The provisions of the previous number shall also apply, with necessary adaptations, to a superior regarding control of subordinates who are under his or her authority and effective control. Article 137

Definitions
For the purposes of this title, the following shall be considered:
a) "Armed conflict of international character" one which:
i) Occurs between states, even without a formal declaration of war, even if one of those States does not recognize that state of war; ii) Corresponds to total or partial occupation of a State's territory, even if that occupation does not meet military resistance; iii) Corresponds to a situation in which peoples fight against colonial domination, foreign occupation and regimes which practice segregation, when the people exercise their right to self-determination enshrined in the United Nations Charter and in the declaration on principles of international law concerning friendly relations and cooperation between States; b) "Armed conflict of non-international character" one which occurs in a State's territory, is of prolonged character and pits governmental authorities against organized groups or organized groups against each other, with the exception of situations in which there are disturbances and in which there are internal tensions, such as sporadic or isolated acts of violence or others of similar character; c) "Protected person":
i) In international armed conflict, persons protected for the purposes of the Geneva Conventions of 1949 and Additional Protocol I, namely wounded, sick, shipwrecked, prisoners of war, sanitary or religious personnel and the civilian population; ii) In armed conflict of non-international character, wounded, sick and shipwrecked persons, and also persons who do not take active part in hostilities but have come into the enemy's hands; iii) In armed conflict of international character and in armed conflict of national character, members of the armed forces and combatants of the enemy party who have already laid down their arms or have no other means of defence. TITLE II CRIMES AGAINST PERSONS

CHAPTER I AGAINST LIFE

Article 138 Simple homicide

A person who kills another person shall be punished with imprisonment from 8 to 20 years. Article 139 Aggravated homicide

An agent who kills another person in circumstances which show special censurability or perversity, in particular, because:
a) He or she uses poison, torture, asphyxiation, fire, explosives or other insidious means or means which constitute the commission of a crime of common danger, or other cruel acts, to increase the victim's suffering; b) He or she uses dissimulation or other means or resources to make it difficult for the victim to defend himself or herself or make it impossible for the victim to defend himself or herself; c) He or she kills because of greed61, because he or she likes to kill people, because he or she wants to obtain sexual excitement or satisfaction, because of payment or reward or promise of payment or reward or because of futile or base motive; d) He or she kills to prepare, execute or conceal another crime, facilitate escape or ensure impunity for the agent of a crime; e) He or she kills because of racial, religious or political hatred; 61 (139) Greed – Strong and insatiable desire; greedy (adj); covetous (for something)

f) He or she kills with premeditation, which exists when he or she uses coldness62 of mind, reflection on the means used or maintains his or her intent to kill for 24 hours; g) When the victim is the agent's spouse, descendant, ascendant, collateral or affine up to the second degree, adoptee or person who lives with him or her in a relationship in which there is hierarchical, economic or labour dependence; h) The victim is extremely vulnerable because of his or her age, illness or physical or mental deficiency; i) The victim is a member of a sovereign body or constitutional political body, member of an administrative body, magistrate, defender, lawyer, officer of justice, official or other person who holds public service, namely while he or she is holding his or her function or because of the function which he or she holds; j) The victim is a witness, declarant, expert, injured party or offended person and the agent commits the crime to prevent testimony, denunciation of facts or complaint or because of his or her intervention in proceedings,
shall be punished with imprisonment from 12 to 25 years. Article 140 Negligent homicide

1. A person who, by negligence, kills another person shall be punished with imprisonment up to 4 years or a fine. 2. In cases where the agent acts with gross63 negligence he or she shall be punished with imprisonment up to 5 years. Article 141* Interruption of pregnancy

A person who causes a pregnant woman to abort, by any means and without that woman's consent, shall be punished with imprisonment from 2 to 8 years. 2.
