Funsionáriu ne’ebé iha inkéritu prosesuál, prosesu jurisdisionál, prosesu tanba kontra-ordenasaun ka dixiplinár, konxientemente, deside ka la deside, promove ka la promove, investiga ka la investiga ka pratika aktu iha nia funsaun, hasoru lei, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 2. Kuandu funsionáriu pratika faktu deskritu iha númeru anteriór ho intensaun atu prejudika ka benefisia ema ruma nia sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 5. 145 (281) Konvense (v) – Uza argumentu razaun metin ka argumentu lójiku hodi halo ema seluk tuir ita nia hanoin; hafiar; lori; dada. 146 (281) Tenta konvense (v) – Hamaus eme ida hodi dada nia ba halo buat ida; haka’as-án atu halo ka konsege buat ruma. 3. Kuandu konduta sira ne’ebé númeru anteriór sira deskreve halakon ema ruma nia liberdade ajente sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. 4. Kuandu ajente pratika konduta anteriór sira tanba neglijénsia groseira pena nia limite mínimu no másimu sei hatún ba sira nia sorin-baluk. Artigu 283 Koasaun ba majistradu

1. Ema ne’ebé, ho violénsia, ameasa ho mal importante ka ho meiu naran ida impede juíz ka prokuradór públiku atu ezerse livremente nia funsaun sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 1 too tinan 4. 2. Kuandu, atu pratika faktu sira-ne’e, ajente uza kargu polítiku, públiku, militár ka polisiál ne’ebé nia kaer, sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. 3. Kuandu, tanba konduta deskrita iha númeru anteriór sira majistradu omite ka pratika aktu ruma hasoru lei expresa no aktu ne’e hamosu prejuizu ba ema-seluk, sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 10. Artigu 284
Obstrusaun ba aktividade jurisdisionál

1. Ema ne’ebé, ho meiu naran ida, halo opozisaun, hamosu difikuldade ka taka-dalan ba desizaun judisiál ho tránzitu iha julgadu atu kumpre ka atu ezekuta sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 5. 2. Kuandu ajente ne’ebé pratika faktu sira previstu iha númeru anteriór sira ezerse funsaun polítika, públika ka militár ne’ebé, tuir nia natureza, tenke taka dalan ba nia atu pratika faktu sira-ne’e nia sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. Artigu 285 Denúnsia kalunioza

1. Ema ne’ebé, ho meiu naran ida, iha autoridade nia oin ka publikamente, ho konxiénsia katak imputasaun ne’e falsu, denunsia ka soe suspeita katak ema ida halo krime

ida, ho intensaun atu halo ema ne’e hasoru prosedimentu kriminál sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 2. Kuandu ajente halo imputasaun falsu kona-ba ilísitu kontra-ordenasionál ka dixiplinár, pena sei hetan atenuasaun extraordinária. 3. Kuandu funsionáriu ne’ebé iha obrigasaun atu hala'o prosedimentu kriminál maka promove dolozamente faktu deskritu iha númeru anteriór sira pena aplikavel nia limite mínimu no másimu sei agrava datoluk ida.. Artigu 286 La partisipasaun

Ema ne’ebé, iha tiha koñesimentu katak ema ruma halo krime públiku ruma no iha obrigasaun atu halo partisipasaun, la partisipa ida sei hetan pena kona-ba krime ne’ebé nia subar ho nia limite mínimu no másimu tun tiha datoluk rua. Artigu 287
Majistradu ka funsionáriu nia prevarikasaun

1. Juíz, prokuradór públiku ka funsionáriu ne’ebé iha prosesu jurisdisionál nia faze naran ida, ho intensaun atu benefisia ka prejudika ema-seluk, pratika aktu ruma ne’ebé tama iha nia podér funsionál ka la pratika aktu ne’ebé nia iha obrigasaun atu pratika sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 6. 2. Kuandu faktu deskritu iha númeru anteriór halo ema ruma lakon nia liberdade ka hamosu prizaun ka detensaun ilegál sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 10. Artigu 288
Advogadu ka defensór públiku nia prevarikasaun

1. Advogadu ka defensór públiku ne’ebé intensionalmente prejudika kauza ne’ebé entrega ba nia patrosíniu sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 1 too tinan 4. 2. Advogadu ka defensór públiku ne’ebé, iha kauza ida de'it, advoga ka ezerse defensoria ba ema sira-ne’ebé sira nia interese iha konflitu, ho intensaun atu benefisia ka

prejudika sira ruma, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 6. Artigu 289 Simulasaun ba krime

1. Ema ne’ebé, la dehan se maka halo, denunsia krime ida ka halo autoridade kompetente suspeita katak ema ruma halo krime ruma, kuandu nia hatene katak laiha krime ida, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 2 ka multa. 2. Faktu ne’e kona-ba kontravensaun, kontra-ordenasaun ka ilísitu dixiplinár karik, ajente sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 1 ka multa. 3. Kuandu funsionáriu ne’ebé iha obrigasaun atu instaura prosedimentu hasoru faktu hakerek hela iha númeru anteriór sira maka pratika faktu sira-ne’e, pena aplikavel nia limite mínimu no másimu sei agrava ho datoluk ida. Artigu 290 Favoresimentu pesoál

1. Ema ne’ebé, totalmente ka parsialmente, impede, frustra147 ka ilude autoridade nia aktividade probatória ka preventiva, ho intensaun ka ho konxiénsia atu evita ema ne’ebé halo krime ida atu hetan pena ka medida ba seguransa, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 2. Tentativa fó-fatin ba punisaun. 3. Kuandu funsionáriu ne’ebé intervein ka iha kompeténsia atu intervein iha prosesu ka iha obrigasaun atu ezekuta pena ka medida ba seguransa ka atu haruka halo ezekusaun ne’e maka pratika favoresimentu ne’e sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 5. 4. Aktu sira-ne’ebé hakerek hela iha númeru 1 la fó-fatin ba pena kuandu:
a)	Ajente pratika faktu ne’e atu evita mós pena ka medida ba seguransa atu aplika ka ezekuta ba nia; b)	Ema ne’ebé ajente hakarak favorese ho nia konduta ne’e ajente nia kónjuje, dexendente, axendente, adotante, adotadu ka parente ka afín too

147 (290) Frustra – halo buat ruma la prodúz nia rezultadu ka efeitu; halo buat ruma falla tiha

grau daruak, ka ema ne’ebé moris ho nia hanesan feen ho lain. Artigu 291
Violasaun ba justisa nia segredu

1. Ema ne’ebé, hasoru determinasaun legál no sem kauza justa, fó-sai ba públiku aktu prosesuál penál ne’ebé tama iha justisa nia segredu nia konteudu ka aktu ne’ebé desizaun ida proibe tiha ona publisidade nia konteudu, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 1 too tinan 4. 2. Kuandu ajente halo violasaun ne’e ho meiu ba komunikasaun sosiál sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 6. TÍTULU VI
KRIME IHA FUNSAUN PÚBLIKA NIA EZERSÍSIU

Artigu 292 Korrupsaun pasiva ba aktu ilísitu

1. Funsionáriu ne’ebé, nia rasik ka hodi ema seluk, ho nia autorizasaun ka ratifikasaun, husu ka simu, ba nia rasik ka ba ema seluk, vantajen patrimoniál ka la patrimoniál ka vantajen ne’e nia promesa, maski nia laiha direitu, atu pratika ka la pratika aktu ruma hasoru obrigasaun ne’ebé nia iha tanba kargu ne’ebé nia kaer, maski aktu ka omisaun ne’e akontese tiha ona molok pedidu ka aseitasaun ne’e mosu, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 15. 2. Kuandu ajente, molok pratika faktu ne’e, voluntariamente rekuza oferesimentu ka promesa ne’ebé nia simu tiha ona ka fó fila-fali vantajen ne’e, ka, vantajen ne’e koiza funjivel karik, nia valór, nia sei la hetan pena. 3. Pena sei hetan atenuasaun espesiál kuandu ajente ajuda duni hetan prova desiziva atu identifika ka kaer responsavel sira seluk. Artigu 293 Korrupsaun pasiva ba aktu lísitu

1. Funsionáriu ne’ebé, nia rasik ka hodi ema seluk, ho nia autorizasaun ka ratifikasaun, husu ka simu, ba nia rasik ka ba ema seluk, vantajen patrimoniál ka la patrimoniál ka vantajen ne’e nia promesa, maski nia laiha direitu, atu pratika ka la pratika aktu ruma la hasoru obrigasaun ne’ebé nia iha tanba kargu ne’ebé nia kaer, maski aktu ka omisaun ne’e akontese tiha ona molok pedidu ka aseitasaun ne’e mosu, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 2. Sei hetan pena hanesan ida-ne’e funsionáriu ne’ebé, nia rasik ka hodi ema seluk, ho nia autorizasaun ka ratifikasaun, husu ka simu, ba nia rasik ka ba ema seluk, vantajen patrimoniál ka la patrimoniál ka vantajen ne’e nia promesa, maski nia laiha direitu, hosi ema ne’ebé husu tiha ona, husu daudaun ka tuirmai sei husu buat ruma ne’ebé nia tenke ezerse funsaun ne’ebé nia kaer para ema ne’e atu hetan. Artigu 294 Korrupsaun ativa

1. Ema ne’ebé, nia rasik ka hodi ema seluk, ho nia autorizasaun ka ratifikasaun, fó ka promete ba funsionáriu ka ba ema seluk ho funsionáriu ne’e nia koñesimentu, vantajen patrimoniál ne’ebé funsionáriu ne’e la iha direitu atu hetan, ho finalidade ne’ebé hatudu hela iha artigu 292, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 10. 2. Kuandu ho hahalok deskritu iha númeru anteriór ajente hakarak hetan finalidade ne’ebé artigu 293 hatudu nia sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 2 ka multa. Artigu 295 Pekulatu

1. Funsionáriu ne’ebé, hasoru lei, halo ninian ka halo ema seluk nian osan ka koiza movel, públiku ka partikulár, ne’ebé entrega hela ba nia ka tama iha nia liman ka nia bele kaer tanba nia funsaun, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 10, kuandu dispozisaun legál seluk la haruka aplika pena todan liu. 2. Funsionáriu ne’ebé empresta, empeña ka, oin naran ida, onera valór ka objetu ne’ebé númeru anteriór temi sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa, kuandu dispozisaun legál seluk la haruka aplika pena todan liu. 3. Kuandu osan ka koiza movel sira-ne’ebé númeru anteriór sira temi iha valór aas-liu dolar amerikanu 5.000 sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 4 too tinan 12 ka tinan 2 too tinan 5, respetivamente. 4. Kuandu osan ka koiza movel sira-ne’ebé númeru 1 temi iha valór ki’ik-liu dolar amerikanu 50 sei aplika pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. Artigu 296 Pekulatu ho uzu

Funsionáriu ne’ebé uza ka husik ema-seluk uza ba fim ne’ebé la tama iha nia destinu veíkulu ka koiza movel seluk ho valór signifikativu, ne’ebé tama iha nia liman ka nia bele kaer tanba nia funsaun, atu hetan ba nia ka ba ema-seluk benefísiu ilejítimu ka hamosu prejuizu ba ema ruma, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 2, kuandu buat sira ne’e tama iha nia liman ka nia bele kaer tanba nia funsaun. Artigu 297 Abuza podér

Funsionáriu ne’ebé abuza podér ka viola obrigasaun, ne’ebé mai hosi funsaun ne’ebé nia kaer, atu hetan benefísiu ba nia ka ba ema-seluk ka hamosu prejuizu ba ema-seluk sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 1 too tinan 4, kuandu dispozisaun legál seluk la haruka aplika pena todan liu. Artigu 298 Abuzu ho forsa públika

Funsionáriu ne’ebé, iha tiha kompeténsia atu uza, rekizita ka haruka uza forsa públika, uza, rekizita ka haruka uza forsa ne’e atu impede ezekusaun ba lei, justisa nia mandadu regulár ka autoridade públika nia orden lejítima

sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3, kuandu dispozisaun legál seluk la haruka aplika pena todan liu. Artigu 299 Partisipasaun ekonómika

1. Funsionáriu ne’ebé tenke intervein iha kontratu ka operasaun ka aktividade seluk, tanba kargu públiku ne’ebé nia kaer, no aproveita kondisaun ne’e atu hetan ba nia ka ba ema-seluk, diretamente ka hodi ema-seluk, vantajen patrimoniál ka, oin naran ida, partisipasaun ekonómika ilísita, no, nune’e, hamosu prejuizu ba interese públiku ne’ebé nia tenke administra, fiskaliza, defende ka realiza, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. 2. Kuandu konduta ne’e hamosu ba Estadu prejuizu aas-liu dolar amerikanu 10.000 sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 15. Artigu 300 Rekuza kooperasaun

Funsionáriu ne’ebé, hetan tiha pedidu hosi autoridade kompetente atu fó kooperasaun atu administra justisa ka ba servisu públiku seluk, no rekuza kooperasaun ne’e ka, maski laiha motivu justifikadu, la fó kooperasaun ne’e, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. Artigu 301 Agravasaun

1. Kuandu kargu polítiku nia titulár ka majistradu ruma maka pratika krime sira-ne’ebé títulu ida-ne’e refere pena respetivu nia limite másimu sei sa'e datoluk ida. 2. Lejislasaun espesiál maka sei fiksa efeitu la penál no prosedimentu kona-ba situasaun sira referidu iha númeru anteriór. Artigu 302 Konseitu funsionáriu
1. Ba lei penál nia efeitu, tama iha expresaun funsionáriu:

a)	Funsionáriu sivíl; b)	Ajente administrativu; c)	Forsa armada no polisiál sira nia membru; d)	Ema ne’ebé, maski provizoriamente ka temporariamente, ho remunerasaun ka gratuitamente148,	voluntariamente ka obrigatoriamente, simu funsaun atu kaer ka kaer ho ema seluk aktividade iha funsaun públika administrativa ka jurisdisionál, ka, iha sirkunstánsia hanesan sira-ne’e, kaer ka kaer ho ema-seluk funsaun iha organizmu ho utilidade públika ka partisipa iha funsaun sira-ne’e. 2. Ba lei penál nia efeitu, sei aplika mós títulu ida-ne’e nia dispozisaun ba ema ne’ebé ezerse funsaun polítika, governativa ka lejizlativa

TÍTULU VII KRIME FALSIFIKASAUN

KAPÍTULU I FALSIFIKASAUN BA DOKUMENTU

Artigu 303
Falsifikasaun ba dokumentu ka notasaun téknika

1. Ema ne’ebé, atu hamosu prejuizu ba ema-seluk ka ba Estadu ka atu hetan benefísiu ilejítimu ba nia rasik ka ba ema-seluk:
a)	Fabrika dokumentu ka notasaun téknika falsu, falsifika ka altera dokumentu ka abuza ema-seluk nia asinatura hodi halo dokumentu falsu; b)	Hatama falsamente149 iha dokumentu ka notasaun téknika faktu juridikamente relevante ; c)	Atesta150 falsamente kona-ba ema, animál ka koiza nia estadu ka kualidade fízika ka psíkika, ho baze iha koñesimentu sientífika; 148 (302) Gratuitamente (adv) – Saugati de’it. 149 (303) Falsamente (adv) – Falsu de’it
150 (303) Atesta (v) - Deklara atu halo ema fiar; sertifika. d)	Uza dokumentu ka notasaun téknika referidu iha alínea anteriór sira, ne’ebé ema seluk fabrika, falsifika ka emite
sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 2. Sei konsidera hanesan notasaun téknika nia falsifikasaun aksaun ne’ebé hamosu perturbasaun ba aparellu tékniku ka automátiku ne’ebé uza hodi influensia notasaun téknika nia rezultadu. 3. Tentativa fó-fatin ba punisaun. Artigu 304 Falsifikasaun agravada

1. Kuandu faktu sira referidu iha artigu anteriór,  
n. 1, kona-ba dokumentu auténtiku ka dokumentu ho forsa hanesan dokumentu auténtiku, testamentu serradu, vale-korreiu, letra-kámbiu, xeke, dokumentu seluk-tan tansmisivel ho endosu ka notasaun téknika kona-ba veíkulu automovel, aeronave ka barku nia identifikasaun, totál ka parsiál, ajente sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 6. 2. Funsionáriu maka pratika faktu sira-ne’ebé hakerek hela iha artigu anteriór ka iha artigu 309, númeru 1, kuandu nia kaer daudaun nia funsaun karik, sei aplika pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. Artigu 305
Dokumentu públiku nia falsifikasaun

Funsionáriu ne’ebé, iha funsaun ne’ebé nia kaer, atu hamosu prejuizu ba ema-seluk ka ba Estadu ka atu hetan benefísiu ilejítimu ba nia ka ba ema-seluk:
a)	Omite faktu ne’ebé dokumentu ne’ebé lei fó fé públika maka sei sertifika ka autentika; ka
b)	Interkala aktu ka dokumentu iha protokolu, rejistu ka livru ofisiál la tuir formalidade legál
sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 6. Artigu 306
Uza dokumentu ba identifikasaun alleiu

Ema ne’ebé, ho intensaun atu hamosu prejuizu ba ema-seluk ka ba Estadu, uza ema-seluk nia dokumentu ba identifikasaun sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 1 ka multa. KAPÍTULU II FALSIFIKASAUN BA MOEDA

Artigu 307 Kontrafasaun ba moeda

1. Ema ne’ebé halo kontrafasaun ba moeda ka depresiasaun ba moeda metálika lejítima, ho intensaun atu hatama iha sirkulasaun hanesan verdadeira, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 10. 2. Kuandu, hamutuk ho faktu sira deskritu iha númeru anteriór, ajente hatama mós moeda ne’e iha sirkulasaun, pena nia limite másimu sei agrava datoluk ida. 3. Ema ne’ebé, tuir akordu ho falsifikadór, tau ba ema atu sosa, hatama iha sirkulasaun ka, ho meiu seluk tan, difunde moeda ne’e sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 3 too tinan 10. Artigu 308 Pasajen ba moeda falsa

Se maka, iha kazu ne'ebé la tama iha artigu anteriór, adkire atu hatama iha sirkulasaun ka hatama duni iha sirkulasaun, fa'an ka, ho meiu naran ida, difunde moeda kontrafeita ka depresiada, hanesan moeda verdadeira, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 6. Artigu 309
Kontrafasaun ba valór seladu ka timbradu

1. Ema ne’ebé pratika kontrafasaun ka falsifikasaun ba valór seladu ka timbradu ne’ebé Estadu timór mesak maka bele fabrika ka fornese, atu fa'an, uza ka, oin seluk tan, hatama iha sirkulasaun hanesan lejítimu, sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 8. 2. Ema ne’ebé pratika faktu deskritu sira-ne’e kona-ba estampilla postál ka meiu ba frankia postál seluk tan

ne’ebé Timór-Leste nia korreiu uza sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 3. Ema ne’ebé uza produtu falsifikadu sira-ne’ebé númeru anteriór sira temi, maski hatene katak produtu sira-ne’e falsifikadu, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 2 ka multa. 4. Tentativa fó-fatin ba punisaun. Artigu 310
Kontrafasaun ba selu, kuñu, marka ka xansela

1. Ema ne’ebé, ho intensaun atu uza hanesan auténtiku ka intaktu, adkire, kontrafáz151 ka falsifika autoridade ka repartisaun públika ruma nia selu, kuñu, marka ka xansela sei hetan pena prizaun tinan 2 too tinan 6. 2. Se maka uza objetu sira-ne’ebé númeru anteriór temi, kuandu nia hatene katak buat ne’e falsifikadu ka laiha autorizasaun hosi ema ne’ebé iha direitu atu fó, sei hetan pena prizaun too tinan 3 ka multa. 3. Kuandu falsifikadór rasik maka uza objetu sira-ne’ebé temi tiha ona pena referidu iha númeru 1 nia limite másimu sei agrava datoluk ida. 4. Tentativa kona-ba faktu sira-ne’ebé númeru 2 deskreve fó-fatin ba punisaun. Artigu 311 Pezu no medida

Article 278
Falsity in testimony or declaration

1. A person who, in testimony as a party, having taken an oath and having received a warning about the penal consequences that will fall upon them for false testimony, gives a false declaration concerning a fact about which they must give testimony shall receive a prison sentence of up to 3 years or a fine. 2. When, due to the conduct described in the previous numbers, someone loses their freedom, the agent shall receive a prison sentence of 2 to 8 years. Article 279
Falsity in testimony, expertise, interpretation or translation

1. A person who, as a witness, expert, technician, translator or interpreter before a tribunal or before a competent official to receive as a means of proof testimony, report, information or translation, gives testimony, presents a report, gives information or makes a false translation shall receive a prison sentence of up to 4 years or a fine. 2. A person who refuses to give testimony or present a report, information or translation when they have no just cause144 shall receive the same penalty. 3. 1. Article 284

1. A person who, by any means, makes opposition, causes difficulty or blocks a judicial decision with res judicata from being fulfilled or executed shall receive a prison sentence of 2 to 5 years. 2. When the agent who commits the acts provided for in the previous numbers exercises a political, public or military function that, according to its nature, should block them from committing these acts, they shall receive a prison sentence of 2 to 8 years. Article 285 Slanderous denunciation

1. A person who, by any means, before an authority or publicly, with awareness that the imputation is false, denounces or spreads suspicion that someone committed a crime

with the intention of subjecting that person to criminal proceedings shall receive a prison sentence of up to 3 years or a fine. 2. Article 286 Non-participation

Prevarication of magistrate or official

1. the second degree, or a person who lives with them as husband and wife. Article 291

When the agent commits this violation through means of social communication, a prison sentence of 2 to 6 years shall be applied. TITLE VI
CRIMES IN THE EXERCISE OF PUBLIC FUNCTION

Article 292 Passive corruption for illicit act

1. An official who, themselves or through another person, with their authorization or ratification, requests or receives, for themselves or for another person, patrimonial or non-patrimonial advantage or the promise of that advantage, even though they have no right to it, to commit or not commit some act against the obligation they have due to the position they hold, even if that act or omission already occurred before the request or acceptance arose, shall receive a prison sentence of 3 to 15 years. 2. When the agent, before committing this fact, voluntarily refuses the offer or promise that they already received or returns the advantage, or, if the advantage is a fungible thing, its value, they shall not receive a penalty. 3. The penalty shall receive special mitigation when the agent indeed helps to obtain decisive proof to identify or capture other responsible persons. Article 293 Passive corruption for licit act

1. An official who, themselves or through another person, with their authorization or ratification, requests or receives, for themselves or for another person, patrimonial or non-patrimonial advantage or the promise of that advantage, even though they have no right to it, to commit or not commit some act not against the obligation they have due to the position they hold, even if that act or omission already occurred before the request or acceptance arose, shall receive a prison sentence of up to 3 years or a fine. 2. An official who, themselves or through another person, with their authorization or ratification, requests or receives, for themselves or for another person, patrimonial or non-patrimonial advantage or the promise of that advantage, even though they have no right to it, from a person who already requested, will soon request or will later request something that they must exercise the function they hold for that person to obtain, shall receive the same penalty. Article 294 Active corruption

1. A person who, themselves or through another person, with their authorization or ratification, gives or promises to an official or to another person with that official's knowledge, patrimonial advantage that the official has no right to receive, with the purpose indicated in article 292, shall receive a prison sentence of 3 to 10 years. 2. When through the conduct described in the previous number the agent wants to obtain the purpose that article 293 indicates, they shall receive a prison sentence of up to 2 years or a fine. Article 295 Embezzlement

1. An official who, against the law, makes their own or makes another person's money or movable thing, public or private, that is entrusted to them or comes into their hands or they can hold due to their function, shall receive a prison sentence of 3 to 10 years, when another legal provision does not order the application of a heavier penalty. 2. An official who lends, pawns or, in any way, encumbers the value or object that the previous number concerns shall receive a prison sentence of up to 3 years or a fine, when another legal provision does not order the application of a heavier penalty. 3. When the money or movable things that the previous numbers concern have a value higher than US$5,000, a prison sentence of 4 to 12 years or 2 to 5 years shall be applied, respectively. 4. When the money or movable things that number 1 concerns have a value lower than US$50, a prison sentence of up to 3 years or a fine shall be applied. Article 296 Embezzlement by use

An official who uses or lets another person use for a purpose that does not fall within its destination a vehicle or other movable thing with significant value, that comes into their hands or they can hold due to their function, to obtain for themselves or for another person illegitimate benefit or cause damage to someone, shall receive a prison sentence of up to 2 years, when these things come into their hands or they can hold them due to their function. Article 297 Abuse of power

An official who abuses power or violates an obligation, that comes from the function they hold, to obtain benefit for themselves or for another person or cause damage to another person shall receive a prison sentence of 1 to 4 years, when another legal provision does not order the application of a heavier penalty. Article 298 Abuse with public force

An official who, having competence to use, requisition or order the use of public force, uses, requisitions or orders the use of that force to prevent the execution of law, a regular mandate of justice or a legitimate order of public authority

shall receive a prison sentence of up to 3 years, when another legal provision does not order the application of a heavier penalty. Article 299 Economic participation

1. An official who, having received a request from a competent authority to give cooperation to administer justice or for another public service, and refuses that cooperation or, despite having no justified motive, does not give that cooperation, shall receive a prison sentence of up to 3 years or a fine. Lei 13/2008, iha 13 Outubru Autorizasaun lejizlativa iha matéria penál

Mekanizmu konstitusionál kona-ba autorizasaun lejizlativa hakerek hela iha artigu 96,  
n. 1, alínea a), iha Repúblika Demokrátika Timór-Leste nia Konstituisaun. Mekanizmu konstitusionál ne’e halo prosesu lejislativu la'o lalais liu: Parlamentu define polítika lejizlativa nia orientasaun jerál ne’ebé hamahon diploma definitivu; Governu maka sei halo armonizasaun ba aspetu ida-idak kona-ba téknika jurídika, nu'udar orientasaun ne’ebé mai hosi Parlamentu Nasionál. Nune’e sei tuir nafatin separasaun iha órgaun konstitusionál ida-idak nia kompeténsia atu ezerse podér lejislativu. Lei ba autorizasaun lejizlativa ida-ne’e fiksa nia konteúdu no extensaun loloos hodi garante respeitu ba sidadaun sira nia direitu, liberdade no garantia fundamentál iha Direitu Penál nia laran. Solusaun sira-ne’ebé aprezenta ne’e haree-tuir mós prinsípiu jerál sira-ne’ebé instrumentu jurídiku internasionál sira-ne’ebé Timór-Leste ratifika tiha ona konsagra, no mós país nia kontextu sosiál no kulturál. Autorizasaun lejizlativa ida ne’e nia konteúdu mós artikula ho Kódigu ba Prosesu Penál no lejislasaun komplementár ne’ebé aprova tiha ona no moris daudaun. Ho aprovasaun ne’e sei la aplika tan subsidiariamente iha Timór-Leste Indonézia nia Kódigu Penál no sei revoga ka armoniza diploma lejislativu sira-ne’ebé liu tiha 20 Maiu 2002 maka moris no iha norma ruma ne’ebé define krime, pena ka medida ba seguransa. Nune’e, ho baze iha Konstituisaun nia artigu 95,  
n. 1, no 96, Parlamentu Nasionál dekreta, atu vale hanesan lei, buat ne’ebé tuirmai ne’e:

Artigu 1 Objetu

Fó hela autorizasaun ba Governu atu aprova Kódigu Penál no revoga lejislasaun vijente iha matéria ida-ne’e, nomeadamente kona-ba definisaun ba krime, pena no medida ba seguransa no sira nia presupostu. Artigu 2 Sentidu no extensaun

1. Kódigu Penál elaboradu ho baze iha autorizasaun lejizlativa ida-ne’e sei tuir prinsípiu no norma konstitusionál no mós norma iha instrumentu internasionál sira-ne’ebé vinkula Estadu timór iha matéria ne’e. 2. Autorizasaun ne’e nia sentidu no extensaun maka tuirmai ne’e:
a)	harii sistema jurídiko-penál ida ne’ebé proteje bem jurídiku esensiál ba vida iha sosiedade timór no reintegra delinkuente iha sosiedade; b)	Konsagra prinsípiu legalidade no proibisaun ba analojia kona-ba lei penál nia aplikasaun, maibé ho posibilidade atu aplika lei ne’ebé, liu tiha krime nia prátika, maka moris kuandu, iha situasaun konkreta, favorese ajente; c)	Estipula katak lei exesionál ka temporária sei aplika ba faktu ne’ebé pratika iha tempu ne’ebé lei moris maski julgamentu halo iha tempu ne’ebé lei ne’e la moris ona; d)	Estabelese norma ne’ebé define fatin no momentu iha ne’ebé ema ida pratika krime ida; e)	Konsagra prinsípiu territorialidade iha lei penál timór nia aplikasaun, hatudu ho limitasaun ida-idak ba prinsípiu ne’e no situasaun sira iha ne’ebé lei ne’e aplika iha territóriu la timór; f)	Regula krime nia presupostu jerál no, iha ne’e, ekipara omisaun ho aksaun, salvu kuandu lei iha intensaun seluk, kuandu rezultadu ruma tama iha krime nia tipu legál no ajente iha obrigasaun atu evita rezultadu ne’e; g)	Estabelese katak, atu iha imputasaun objetiva, tenke iha neksu de kauzalidade entre konduta no rezultadu típiku; h)	Atu iha imputasaun objetiva tenke iha dolu ka neglijénsia, no sei define dolu nia tipu oioin (diretu, nesesáriu no eventuál) no neglijénsia nia tipu oioin (konxiente no inkonxiente); i)	Prevee katak responsabilidade kriminál tanba krime previstu iha Kódigu Penál labele tranzmite no nia ajente maka de'it pesoa singulár, maibé admite mós katak bele iha responsabilidade tanba aktuasaun ho ema seluk nia nia naran no lejislasaun espesiál bele konsagra pesoa koletiva nia responsabilidade kriminál; superveniente, no admite mós katak kúmulu bele fó-fatin ba prizaun too tinan 30 no multa too loron 600; r)	Define krime kontinuadu no regra kona-ba nia punisaun ho pena aplikavel ba konduta ne’ebé todan liu; s)	Konsagra kauza ne’ebé exklui ilisitude no kulpa, no autonomiza sistematikamente sira ida-idak no define presupostu ba ida-idak nia aplikasaun; t)	Hatama iha títulu ida sirkunstánsia oioin ne’ebé, maski la tama iha tipu legál, iha relevánsia atu determina ajente nia responsabilidade kriminál; u)	Enumera159 sirkunstánsia agravante jerál no mós sirkunstánsia atenuante jerál; v)	Prevee kláuzula jerál kona-ba atenuasaun extraordinária, hamutuk ho kazu espesiál sira previstu iha lei no delimita sira nia konsekuénsia iha moldura penál nia determinasaun, ho modelu ida ne’ebé hatama atenuasaun nia grau oioin; w)	Hanesan sirkunstánsia agravante modifikativa jerál, konsagra reinsidénsia no abitualidade kriminál ho sira-nia presupostu no konsekuénsia ba pena; x)	harii sistema ida kona-ba pena no medida ba seguransa no hatuur nia diferensa iha ajente ne’ebé pratika faktu iha kapasidade ka lae atu hetan kulpa; iha kazu ida dahuluk pena konkreta labele todan liu ajente nia kulpa no iha kazu ida daruak tenke fundamenta iha ajente nia perigozidade; y)	Enunsia prinsípiu determinante160 atu hili pena no medida ba seguransa no determinante mós kona-ba pena no medida ba seguransa nia efeitu no kona-ba kontajen ba tempu iha ne’ebé iha privasaun ba liberdade molok iha kondenasaun; z)	Kona-ba pena ho medida privativa ba liberdade nia ezekusaun, prevee posibilidade atu fó liberdade kondisionál no rejime ba prova, kuandu, ho vizadu nia konsentimentu no ho rekizitu sira-seluk ne’ebé sei hakerek iha lejislasaun komplementár ne’ebé sei prevee kondisaun

Law 13/2008, of 13 October Legislative authorization in penal matters

The constitutional mechanism concerning legislative authorization is set out in article 96, no. 1, subparagraph a), of the Constitution of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste. This constitutional mechanism makes the legislative process proceed more quickly: Parliament defines the general orientation of legislative policy which frames the definitive diploma; the Government shall harmonize each aspect concerning legal technique, according to the orientation coming from the National Parliament. Thus the separation in the competence of each constitutional organ to exercise legislative power shall continue to be followed. This law for legislative authorization fixes its content and exact extension in order to guarantee respect for the fundamental rights, freedoms and guarantees of citizens in the area of Criminal Law. The solutions presented also take into account the general principles which the international legal instruments which Timor-Leste has ratified consecrate, and also the social and cultural context of the country. The content of this legislative authorization also articulates with the Code of Criminal Procedure and complementary legislation which has already been approved and is in force. With this approval Indonesian Criminal Code shall no longer be applied subsidiarily in Timor-Leste and legislative diplomas which came into force after 20 May 2002 and have any norm which defines crimes, penalties or security measures shall be revoked or harmonized. Thus, based on articles 95, no. 1, and 96 of the Constitution, the National Parliament decrees, to be valid as law, the following:

Article 1 Object

Legislative authorization is given to the Government to approve the Criminal Code and revoke legislation in force in this matter, namely concerning the definition of crimes, penalties and security measures and their presuppositions. Article 2 Meaning and extension

1. The Criminal Code elaborated on the basis of this legislative authorization shall follow the constitutional principles and norms and also the norms in the international instruments which bind the Timorese State in this matter. 2. The meaning and extension of this authorization are as follows:
a) To establish a legal-penal system which protects legal goods essential to life in Timorese society and reintegrates the delinquent into society; b) To consecrate the principle of legality and the prohibition of analogy concerning the application of penal law, but with the possibility of applying the law which, after the commission of the crime, comes into force when, in a concrete situation, it favors the agent; c) To stipulate that exceptional or temporary law shall apply to acts committed during the time such law is in force even if the judgment is made at a time when such law is no longer in force; d) To establish norms which define the place and moment at which a person commits a crime; e) To consecrate the principle of territoriality in the application of Timorese penal law, indicating each limitation on this principle and the situations in which such law applies in non-Timorese territory; f) To regulate the general presuppositions of crime and, in this, to equate omission with action, except when the law has another intent, when any result enters into the legal type of crime and the agent has an obligation to avoid such result; g) To establish that, in order to have objective imputation, there must be a causal nexus between conduct and typical result; h) In order to have objective imputation there must be intent or negligence, and the various types of intent (direct, necessary and eventual) and the various types of negligence (conscious and unconscious) shall be defined; i) To provide that criminal responsibility for crimes provided for in the Criminal Code may not be transmitted and only singular persons are its agents, but also to admit that there may be responsibility for acting in the name of another person and special legislation may consecrate the criminal responsibility of collective persons; j) To consecrate the inimputability of minors under 16 years of age and also the requirements for inimputability by reason of psychic anomaly; k) To admit that the penalty may be aggravated when the agent's responsibility, at least for negligence, must embrace a result which does not enter into the type; l) To consecrate error concerning circumstances as a basis for removing intent and error concerning illicitness as a basis for removing culpability; m) Concerning the various forms of crime, to establish as a principle that preparatory acts may not give rise to punishment, and also rules concerning the punishment of attempt in intentional crimes which give rise to imprisonment higher than 3 years; n) To define the concept of attempt, the punishment of attempt up to where, cases in which there is impossible attempt, voluntary desistance and subsequent repentance, in singular action or in participation; o) To establish the various forms of authorship, instigation or complicity, and to define the responsibility of participants in culpability and illicitness; p) To provide for and define presuppositions for situations in which many crimes enter into concurrence, many sanctions enter into concurrence, crimes enter into concurrence with another infraction and many norms enter into concurrence; q) To establish rules concerning punishment for crimes which enter into concurrence, even with supervenient knowledge, and also to admit that cumulation may give rise to imprisonment for up to 30 years and a fine for up to 600 days; r) To define continued crime and rules concerning its punishment with the penalty applicable to the most serious conduct; s) To consecrate causes which exclude illicitness and culpability, and to autonomize them systematically and define the presuppositions for the application of each; t) To include in one title the various circumstances which, even if they do not enter into the legal type, have relevance to determine the agent's criminal responsibility; u) To enumerate159 general aggravating circumstances and also general attenuating circumstances; v) To provide for a general clause concerning extraordinary attenuation, together with special cases provided for in the law and to delimit their consequences in the determination of the penal framework, with a model which includes various degrees of attenuation; w) As general modificative aggravating circumstances, to consecrate recidivism and criminal habituality with their presuppositions and consequences for the penalty; x) To establish a system concerning penalties and security measures and to base their difference on whether the agent who committed the act has capacity or not to receive culpability; in the first case the concrete penalty may not be more serious than the agent's culpability and in the second case it must be based on the agent's dangerousness; y) To enunciate principles determinative160 for choosing the penalty and security measure and also determinative concerning the effect of penalties and security measures and concerning the counting of time in which there is deprivation of liberty before conviction; z) Concerning the execution of penalties and measures privative of liberty, to provide for the possibility of granting conditional release and probation regime, when, with the consent of the convict and with other requirements which shall be set out in complementary legislation which shall provide for conditions

159 Enumerate (v) – To make a list. To enumerate aggravating circumstances = To include in a list the aggravating circumstances. 160 Determinative (adj) – Fundamental; which serves as a basis; which serves as a foundation; which has great influence. for the execution of imprisonment, the rights and obligations of prisoners and also open regime; aa) To establish a system of criminal sanctions for imputables based on the following principal penalties: imprisonment, fine, community service and admonishment; bb) Imprisonment with its minimum duration of 30 days and maximum of 30 years, with the possibility of suspending its execution when the penalty applied is not longer than 3 years and the fulfillment of such penalty is not necessary to prevent future crime, with or without conditions to fulfill any duty and/or to enter into accompaniment for reinsertion during the period of suspension; cc) To regulate the possibility of modifying the suspension regime which is newly applied and the revocation of suspension when during the period of suspension the convict commits an intentional crime which gives rise to him or her receiving a penalty of imprisonment or in the case where there is intentional non-fulfillment of the obligation which falls upon him or her; dd) To consecrate a regime concerning the substitution of imprisonment applied which is not longer than 12 months with a fine or community service, according to each circumstance, with an obligation on the court to justify non-substitution in situations where, even if possible, this measure is not applied; ee) Not to give correspondence between alternative imprisonment and substitutive fine and, when there is unjustified non-payment of such fine, to give an obligation to apply imprisonment which is newly applied; ff) To stipulate that the fine penalty must be fixed according to time, with its minimum of 10 days and its maximum of 360 days, as a rule, and to determine that each day of fine shall have correspondence with an amount, with its minimum of half a dollar and its maximum of 200 dollars, which shall be fixed according to the convict's economic and financial situation; gg) When directly applying a fine penalty, to stipulate an obligation to give correspondence to such fine with alternative imprisonment for a corresponding time reduced by 2/3, and also the possibility of paying the fine by installment, reduction or exemption of such fine in cases

where there is great supervenient difficulty or impossibility of paying such fine; hh) To provide for the possibility of placing a penalty of community service in place of a penalty of imprisonment or a penalty of fine in situations concerning petty criminality and medium criminality and to establish conditions for its application and execution according to coordination with reinsertion services, and also cases concerning exemption or reduction, and to leave to complementary law to regulate other conditions concerning the application and functioning of this penalty; ii) To consecrate the penalty of admonishment for cases not punishable with abstract imprisonment longer than 3 years, namely, cumulatively, where there is reparation for damage, the agent is a primary delinquent and admonishment is sufficient to make prevention and recovery; jj) To establish a system of accessory penalties, in which, by reason of certain crimes, rights and the exercise of professions shall be prohibited, namely, temporary suspension from public function, prohibition from exercising functions, prohibition from driving, cancellation of license to possess firearms and expulsion of foreigners; these accessory penalties do not function automatically but are applied only when a principal penalty is applied and their measure varies according to the measure of culpability; kk) To consecrate for those who have already been declared inimputable by reason of psychic anomaly the possibility of applying a security measure, with limited temporal duration, namely internment when dangerousness counsels it and also to consecrate that the obligation to apply such measure ends when the state which gave rise to such measure ends, and for foreigners expulsion may be placed in place of such measure; ll) To provide also for inimputables by reason of psychic anomaly measures of professional interdiction, cancellation of license and prohibition from driving; mm) To establish an autonomous chapter concerning the determination of concrete penalty, for imprisonment and for fine, indicating general principles and operations necessary for the choice and quantification of such penalty; nn) To establish that civil law regulates compensation for loss and damage arising from the commission of crime, and also its presuppositions and calculation, but, except for another declaration by the injured party, the court shall award compensation ex officio and the credit arising from this shall have privilege; oo) To determine conditions which give rise to the court declaring forfeited objects or advantages arising from crime; pp) To define, as a criterion for exercising the right to complaint, the various crimes as public or semi-public, to identify the holder of this right, the time limit for exercising this right and conditions for renunciation and desistance of this right; qq) Concerning the extinction of criminal responsibility, to fix the time limit for the prescription of criminal proceedings, taking into account the various frameworks of the various crimes, how to count and causes for the suspension of prescription; rr) To fix the time limit for the prescription of penalties, security measures and accessory penalties, and also situations which give rise to the suspension of prescription; ss) To regulate other extinctions of responsibility, by reason of the agent's death, by reason of amnesty, by reason of generic pardon and by reason of pardon; tt) To consecrate imprescriptibility for criminal proceedings and penalties for war crimes, crimes against peace, humanity and freedom; uu) To organize the special part of the Criminal Code, book II, in which the various types of crime are included according to the legal good protected in titles and chapters as homogeneous as possible; vv) In title I to include illicit acts concerning the crime of genocide and crimes against humanity, war crimes, including prohibited conducts which use methods and means referred to in international law, war crimes against property and against goods protected with distinctive insignia or emblem or other rights, and, also in this title, the crime called crime against peace and freedom, namely to prohibit incitement to war, racially or religiously discriminatory conduct, trafficking and enslavement

of persons and also to consecrate a type of crime concerning terrorism; ww) In title I of the general part the future Criminal Code of Timor-Leste must also pay attention to the international obligations which the Country has already accepted when it subscribed to and ratified the Statute of the International Criminal Court; xx) In title II of the special part legal goods which are eminently personal shall be protected, such as life, physical integrity, personal freedom, honor and protection of private life; yy) To structure protection of the legal good life with provision for various penal frameworks according to what type of culpability the agent has (intent and negligence) and circumstances which qualify the degree of censurability as lesser or greater, namely according to its motive, the quality of the victim and the means and method used to realize the criminal design; zz) To consecrate protection of uterine life; to provide as privileged the conduct of an infanticidal parturient in limited cases which happen during childbirth by reason of the disturbing influence of childbirth; to criminalize incitement to suicide and abandonment or intentional exposure of another person which creates danger to life; aaa) To define a broad incriminating norm which prohibits conduct violating the physical integrity of another person, with graduation of the abstract penal framework according to the agent's illicitness and culpability which is indicated in the gravity of the injury, according to the type of culpability and according to whether the result which exceeds the criminal design formulated may give rise to imputation or not, at least for negligence - what doctrine calls aggravation by result; bbb) To autonomize incrimination for offense with poisonous substance, reciprocal offense and participation in a fight with two or more persons; ccc) In the context of bodily offense, to implement two legal types of crime which provide for punishment for ill-treatment of minors or incapables and for spouse or person who lives as husband or wife; ddd) In the chapter concerning personal freedom, conduct which, traditionally and according to comparative law, integrates the types of crime of threat, coercion, kidnapping, abduction, and other acts which violate individual freedom and, specifically, to create a typical illicit act concerning trafficking in persons and omission of denunciation with respect to situations which may constitute these crimes; eee) To consecrate a chapter on sexual criminality, with emphasis on the legal good of freedom in this area as determinative for the conduct to be criminalized, in order to protect those who are still younger from acts for which they do not yet have preparation to, according to their conscience, decide with freedom, to incriminate conduct which constitutes the most common forms of sexual exploitation and sexual abuse, such as with fraud or by reason of age; fff) To incriminate especially practices which constitute sexual prostitution, child pornography and other sexual acts with minors under 12 years of age; ggg) To include criminalization for violation of secrecy, violation of domicile and other places and violation of correspondence and telecommunications; hhh) To bring together in one title only the crimes which protect legal goods concerning public peace and tranquility, the security of the State, life in society, against public authority and in the context of electoral activity; iii) Concerning conduct which may violate public peace and tranquility, to prevent criminal association, public instigation to commit crime, participation in public riot, conduct which prevents citizens from exercising political rights, disobedience to legitimate order to disperse, to criminalize practices which constitute trafficking in influence and also to punish abuse of public signs or uniforms; jjj) Concerning the internal security of the State, to provide for incriminating norms for conduct which may actually create danger to such security, namely to consecrate as legal types of crime treason to the fatherland, collaboration with enemy armed forces of the Timorese State, sabotage of national defense and campaign against efforts

for peace in Timor-Leste, attack against the Head of State or other constitutional organs or conduct which seeks to alter the State according to law, diplomatic infidelity161, violation of State secrecy and outrage162 to Timorese national symbols; kkk) To criminalize fraudulent conduct in electoral activity independently of its agent and the phase of the electoral process, obstruction of exercising candidacy or illegal exercise of candidacy, electoral propaganda against the respective legal framework163 and actions which disturb the normal development of electoral acts; lll) Life in modern society develops together with conduct which may give rise to danger with more or less proximate concretization and may violate goods whose integrity must be guaranteed, such as driving motor vehicles, using or possessing weapons and activity with relevance to citizens and public health; therefore some types of crime concerning this matter must be provided for; mmm) Thus also conduct which violates religious values implanted in Timorese society, non-fulfillment of alimentary obligation and other obligations concerning the custody of minors, of solidarity in calamity or disaster or obligations which fall upon certain professional activities must be criminalized; nnn) To criminally sanction conduct harmful164 and unsustainable to the environment, namely fauna, flora, natural habitat and resources in the Timorese subsoil; ooo) To criminally sanction conduct against the exercise of public authority, namely with acts which constitute disobedience, obstruction, destruction, resistance or usurpation of public office; ppp) Concerning the executing action of penalties and security measures which remove liberty, to criminalize conduct which constitutes removal of prisoner, evasion,

161 Infidelity (s) – Treason; violation of trust
162 Outrage (s) – Offense; fault. 163 Framework (s) – Disposition. Legal framework = legal disposition; norm. 164 Harmful (adj) – Which harms or creates prejudice

assistance by an official for evasion and riot of prisoners; qqq) In order to protect patrimonial legal goods to consecrate in one chapter crimes against property and in another chapter crimes against patrimony; rrr) To establish a normative system protective of property based on the legal types of crime which have long been used in other penal legislation, such as theft, robbery, breach of trust and damage, and to structure these types as simple and aggravated, according to circumstances such as the value and nature of the thing appropriated, the means used, how the action is, violence, threat or coercion or other circumstances which may significantly increase culpability and illicitness; sss) Concerning property, to also autonomize norms which typify theft for use of vehicle, violence following subtraction, usurpation of immovable and alteration of boundary marker, also to incriminate involuntary damage and to define prohibited burning and types of arson as typical crimes concerning special damage by reason of the means and danger which it represents with the consequences which arise from such conduct; ttt) To protect patrimony in general with the following common incriminations, such as fraud, extortion, receiving and bankruptcy or insolvency, but especially computer fraud and various harmful and abusive administration, looking to new needs which arise in commerce with new technology and looking to the responsibility which must be demanded from persons who manage the goods or patrimony of another person and do not act correctly in such administration; uuu) In modern and democratic society justice and the exercise of justice are also goods which must receive penal protection; thus punishment must be consecrated for falsity of procedural acts, for various obstructions to jurisdictional activity, non-exercise of jurisdictional activity when it constitutes denial of justice and violation of the secrecy of justice; vvv) To also include incrimination for acts which constitute bribery, prevarication of magistrate or official and lawyer or public defender, and also other activity concerning personal favoritism in justice, together

with classic incriminations such as calumnious denunciation, simulation of crime or non-participation; www) Together with the references set out in the last two numbers, conduct must also be criminalized which, in the exercise of public function, constitutes corruption, peculation, abuse of power or public force or economic participation in business by persons who exercise public office or function; xxx) In one autonomous title conduct which constitutes falsification of document, technical notation, currency and sealed or stamped value, weights and measures, marks, stamps and seals must be prevented with adequate incriminating norms, with their various sanctions according to the nature, probative or fiduciary value and public use or destination of the falsified object, and to provide for the possibility of seizure and forfeiture of objects intended to commit these crimes; yyy) In the area of the economy acts which constitute fiscal fraud or smuggling and evasion of duties concerning customs or border matters shall also be incriminated, together with criminal punishment for disobedience to requisition which the government orders and conduct which may disturb, prejudice or prevent the realization of any public act, such as public tender or judicial auction. Article 3
Articulation with the Code of Criminal Procedure

The Criminal Code which this legislative authorization refers to must articulate its moment of coming into force with the Code of Criminal Procedure and regulatory legislation concerning penal matters which is already in force, in order to guarantee legal security and coherence in the respective legal order. Article 4 Duration and extension

The legislative authorization given by this law is in force for 180 days, beginning at the moment this law comes into force. Article 5 Coming into force

This legal diploma comes into force on the day following its publication. Approved on 23 September 2008

President of the National Parliament in exercise Maria da Paixão de Jesus da Costa

Promulgated on 7 October 2008 Let it be published. President of the Republic Dr. José Ramos Horta

Artigu 1 Alterasaun ba Kódigu Penál

Artigu 141 iha Kódigu Penál aprovadu ho Dekretu-Lei 19/2009, iha 8 Abríl, no aneksu iha diploma ne'e, altera tiha hanesan tuirmai ne'e:

“Artigu 141 (…)

1. (…)
2. (…)
3. (…)
4. Númeru anteriór nia dispozisaun la aplika kuandu, tuir koñesimentu no experiénsia médika ne'ebé iha ona no halo tiha buat hotu ne'ebé bele halo atu salva feto isin-rua no

fetu ka embriaun nia vida, interrupsaun ba gavidéz maka bele hadook mate hosi feto isin-rua, naran katak iha sertifikasaun médika no médiku maka halo ka profisionál seluk iha saúde maka halo, ho médiku nia diresaun, iha estabelesimentu ba saude públiku ka ofisialmente rekoñesidu, no ho feto isin-rua nia konsentimentu. 5. Molok halo interrupsaun painél ida ho médiku na'in tolu tenke sertifika sirkunstánsia sira referida iha númeru anteriór, iha atestadu médiku eskritu no asinadu; iha painél ne'e halo parte médiku ida-ne'ebé realiza ka superviziona interrupsaun ba gravidéz nia realizasaun. 6. Konsentimentu feto isin-rua maka sei fó rasik iha dokumentu eskritu no asinadu, rona tiha, kuandu bele, nia kónjuje, ka ema ne'ebé moris ho nia hanesan lain ho feen, ka ema seluk, tuir feto ne'e nia pedidu, maka fó, no, kuandu bele, sei fó tiha loron rua uluk molok atu halo interrupsaun ne'e. 7. Kuandu feto isin-rua ema menór ida, nia reprezentante legál maka sei fó konsentimentu. 8. Kuandu feto isin-rua maiór ka emansipada ema inkapáz psikikamente ida ka ema-ne'ebé sofre hela inkapasidade psíkika, nia kónjuje ka ema ne'ebé moris ho nia hanesan lain ho feen, ka nia reprezentante legál, axendente ka dexendente, ka, laiha karik, nia parente kolaterál ruma, respetiva no susesivamente, maka fó konsentimentu ne'e. 9. Kuandu labele hetan atestadu médiku referidu iha n. 5 no/ka labele hetan konsentimentu nu'udar hakerek hela iha
n. 6 too 8, no interrupsaun tenke halo lalais no labele hein tan ona, médiku, haree ba situasaun ida-idak, maka sei deside, uza mós, kuandu bele, médiku seluk sira nia paresér. 10. Iha painél referidu iha n. 5 sei tama médiku ne'ebé iha koñesimentu adekuadu atu avalia sirkunstánsia ne'ebé justifika interrupsaun ba gravidéz, no, kuandu bele, médiku jinekolojista/obstetra ida. 11. Médiku sira-ne'ebé emite atestadu médiku no médiku sira-ne'ebé realiza ka superviziona interrupsaun ba gravidéz nia realizasaun tenke fó esklaresimentu nesesáriu ba feto isin-rua no, kuandu tama iha situasaun ne'e, ba ema sira-ne'ebé n. 7 no 8 refere, nomeadamente kona-ba métodu atu uza iha interrupsaun, interrupsaun

ne'e nia efeitu rasik no nia konsekuénsia ba feto isin-rua nia saude fízika no psíkika. 12. Médiku no profisionál ba saude seluk sira iha direitu atu aprezenta objesaun tuir sira-nia konxiénsia hasoru aktu ruma kona-ba interrupsaun ba gravidéz. 13. Médiku no profisionál ba saude seluk sira-ne'ebé invoka objesaun tuir sira-nia konxiénsia tenke garante profisionál iha saúde seluk nia intervensaun imediata iha aktu sira-ne'ebé tenke halo no mós akompañamentu imediatu ba feto isin-rua. 14. Objesaun tuir konxiénsia tenke hatudu expresamente no tenke fó-hatene ba responsavel klíniku iha estabelesimentu ba saude iha ne'ebé objetór servisu”. Artigu 2 Moris

1, and 98, the National Parliament decrees, to have the force of law, the following:

Article 1 Amendment to the Penal Code

Article 141 of the Penal Code approved by Decree-Law 19/2009, of 8 April, and annexed to that diploma, is amended as follows:

"Article 141 (…)

1. (…)
2. (…)
3. (…)
4. The provision of the preceding number does not apply when, according to existing medical knowledge and experience and having done everything that can be done to save the pregnant woman and

the fetus or embryo's life, the interruption of pregnancy is what can avert death from the pregnant woman, namely with medical certification and performed by a doctor or other health professional, under the direction of a doctor, in a public health establishment or officially recognized, and with the pregnant woman's consent. 5. Before performing the interruption a panel of three doctors must certify the circumstances referred to in the preceding number, in a written and signed medical certificate; in that panel shall be included the doctor who performs or supervises the performance of the interruption of pregnancy. 6. The consent of the pregnant woman shall be given personally in a written and signed document, having heard, when possible, her spouse, or the person with whom she lives as if married, or another person, at the request of that woman, who shall give it, and, when possible, shall be given at least two days before performing that interruption. 7. When the pregnant woman is a minor, her legal representative shall give consent. 8. When the pregnant woman is an adult or emancipated person who is psychically incapable or a person who is suffering from psychic incapacity, her spouse or the person with whom she lives as if married, or her legal representative, ascendant or descendant, or, if there is none, any collateral relative, respectively and successively, shall give that consent. 9. When the medical certificate referred to in no. 5 cannot be obtained and/or the consent as written in
nos. 6 to 8 cannot be obtained, and the interruption must be performed urgently and cannot be delayed any longer, the doctor, having regard to each situation, shall decide, also using, when possible, the opinion of other doctors. 10. In the panel referred to in no. 5 shall be included a doctor who has adequate knowledge to evaluate the circumstances that justify the interruption of pregnancy, and, when possible, a gynecologist/obstetrician. 11. The doctors who issue the medical certificate and the doctors who perform or supervise the performance of the interruption of pregnancy must provide the necessary clarifications to the pregnant woman and, when it falls within the situation, to the persons whom nos. 7 and 8 refer to, namely concerning the method to be used in the interruption, the interruption

itself and its effects and its consequences for the pregnant woman's physical and psychic health. 12. Doctors and other health professionals have the right to present conscientious objection to any act concerning the interruption of pregnancy. 13. Doctors and other health professionals who invoke conscientious objection must guarantee the immediate intervention of another health professional in the acts that must be performed and also the immediate accompaniment of the pregnant woman. 14. Conscientious objection must be expressed explicitly and must be made known to the clinical head in the health establishment where the objector works". Article 2 Entry into force

This diploma enters into force on the day following its publication. Approved on 26 May 2009

President of the National Parliament Fernando La Sama de Araújo

Promulgated on 3 July 2009 Published by

President of the Republic José Ramos Horta
